title: Experienced Etsy Listing Specialist / Etsy Lister
description:
We are looking for an experienced Etsy Listing Specialist to prepare and upload product listings to our Etsy stores.



Previous experience working directly inside Etsy is required for this position.



You will receive product information, prepared images, and keyword research, and your job will be to create optimized Etsy listings according to our internal processes.



Your responsibilities will include:



Creating new product listings directly inside Etsy

Using ChatGPT to prepare listing titles, descriptions, tags, and other listing content

Creating listing content based on provided keywords

Uploading product images that have already been prepared

Organizing images in the correct order

Entering product information accurately

Selecting the appropriate Etsy categories and attributes

Adding tags and SEO information

Expanding keyword or competitor research when necessary using eRank and EverBee

Reviewing the listing before completion

Saving every product as DRAFT ONLY

Following our listing templates and standard operating procedures



Requirements:



Previous hands-on experience with the Etsy seller dashboard

Understanding of Etsy listings and Etsy SEO

Experience creating titles, descriptions, and tags

Good attention to detail

Ability to follow detailed instructions and templates

Experience with ChatGPT



Advantages:



Experience with eRank

Experience with EverBee

Previous experience managing or listing products for multiple Etsy stores



Important:

You will not publish the listings. All products must be prepared and saved as Drafts only for final review.

title: Senior Ecommerce Customer Experience Manager | Shopify + Gorgias
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Senior Ecommerce Customer Experience Manager** to help us rebuild our customer support operation from the ground up.



This is **not a standard customer service representative or virtual assistant position**.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already worked inside a well-run ecommerce customer support operation and has experience managing people, building processes, improving workflows, and creating an exceptional customer experience.



We currently use **Freshdesk for
 support and Tidio for live chat**, and we are considering migrating our support operation to **Gorgias**. Strong Gorgias experience is therefore highly preferred.



Our business serves primarily US customers and fulfills products through several different manufacturers, suppliers, sellers, and fulfillment partners. Because of this, our customer support operation deals with everything from simple product questions to complicated production, shipping, customization, refund, replacement, and fulfillment issues.



Your first responsibility will be to audit our existing customer support operation and help management determine what needs to change.



You will be expected to:



* Audit customer conversations and identify weaknesses in our current customer experience

* Review our Freshdesk and Tidio workflows

* Help design a stronger overall customer support structure

* Help plan and potentially lead our migration to Gorgias

* Build tags, views, macros, rules, workflows, and automations

* Establish clear ticket ownership and escalation procedures

* Create SOPs for common customer situations

* Develop proactive follow-up systems so customers never feel forgotten

* Create systems for customers waiting on production, suppliers, replacements, or shipping

* Establish response-time, follow-up, and resolution standards

* Implement CSAT and other meaningful customer service KPIs

* Create agent QA and performance-review processes

* Train, coach, and improve the existing customer support team

* Improve communication between customer support, fulfillment, suppliers, and management

* Create clear refund, replacement, goodwill, and customer-recovery guidelines

* Help reduce negative reviews, customer complaints, and chargebacks

* Identify recurring customer problems and help management address their root causes

* Build reporting that gives management clear visibility into customer experience and agent performance



We are looking for someone with strong experience in:



* Ecommerce customer experience

* Shopify

* Gorgias

* Freshdesk

* Managing customer support teams

* Building customer support SOPs and workflows

* Helpdesk automation

* CSAT and support KPIs

* Agent coaching and QA

* Escalation management

* Refunds, replacements, returns, and order recovery

* Shipping delays and lost packages

* International fulfillment

* Supplier or 3PL coordination

* Chargebacks and disputes

* Difficult customer situations

* Proactive customer follow-up



Experience supporting **US ecommerce customers** is strongly preferred.



The ideal candidate thinks beyond simply answering tickets.



When a customer complains, we want someone who asks:



Why did this happen?



How many other customers are experiencing the same problem?



What can we change so it doesn't happen again?



Our goal is to build a customer support culture where **customers never feel forgotten and never have to chase us for an update**.



Even when production, supplier, or shipping problems happen, the customer should always feel that someone is actively looking after them until the situation is completely resolved.



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily answering customer
s or chats.



We are looking for someone who has **managed, built, or significantly improved an ecommerce customer support operation**.



When applying, please begin your application with the words **"CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE"** so we know you have read the entire job description.



In your application, please briefly explain:



* The largest customer support team you have managed

* Your experience with Shopify and Gorgias

* A customer support operation or process you significantly improved

* What you would focus on during your first 30 days if customer complaints had increased significantly



This is intended to be a **long-term, full-time position**. The right person may eventually take full responsibility for managing the customer support department.

title: Dispatcher (HVAC & Electrical)
description:
Remote Service Operations & Project Coordinator — HVAC / Electrical



We are a U.S.-based HVAC and Electrical service company looking for a reliable, highly organized, and proactive Remote Service Operations & Project Coordinator.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or call-center position.



We need someone who can take responsibility for the administrative and coordination side of our customer jobs and projects — from the moment a customer contacts us until the work, inspection, and follow-up are completed.



Your main responsibility is simple:



Make sure every customer request and every active project keeps moving forward without the owner having to constantly call people, chase information, or remind you what needs to be done.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Managing incoming customer requests and active jobs

* Scheduling service calls, installations, follow-up visits, and inspections

* Managing and updating the company calendar

* Communicating with customers by phone, text, and

* Confirming appointments and arrival windows

* Rescheduling appointments when necessary

* Following up with customers regarding estimates, approvals, scheduling, and project status

* Answering customer questions related to scheduling and project coordination

* Handling routine customer concerns and finding solutions

* Keeping customers informed when schedules, equipment deliveries, or project timelines change

* Calling suppliers and distributors

* Checking equipment and material availability

* Requesting pricing and order information

* Tracking equipment and material orders

* Confirming delivery dates and pickup availability

* Coordinating deliveries and pickups with technicians

* Communicating with technicians and installers regarding schedules and project requirements

* Making sure technicians have the information needed before arriving at a job

* Coordinating permit and inspection scheduling

* Contacting cities, counties, inspectors, utilities, and other organizations when necessary

* Scheduling inspections with customers and field teams

* Tracking inspection results and required follow-up

* Following up on unfinished jobs and open customer requests

* Monitoring estimates and contacting customers when follow-up is required

* Collecting missing information, photos, documents, model numbers, or other project details

* Updating job notes and customer information in the CRM

* Making sure no customer request or project is forgotten or left without a next action



What We Expect



We are looking for someone who does not wait to be told every individual step.



For example:



If equipment is expected to arrive tomorrow, you should check the status before the installation.



If the supplier says the equipment is delayed, you should determine the new ETA, communicate with the customer, coordinate with the field team, adjust the schedule if necessary, and update the CRM.



The owner should not have to ask:



“Did you call them?”



You should already know what needs to be followed up on.



Required Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong phone communication skills

* Excellent organization

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to manage many jobs and conversations at the same time

* Ability to follow up consistently

* Ability to solve routine problems independently

* Comfortable making phone calls throughout the day

* Comfortable speaking with customers, technicians, suppliers, inspectors, and government offices

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Quiet professional workspace

* Ability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



* HVAC

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* Construction

* Home services

* Property management

* Service dispatching

* Project coordination

* Construction administration

* Customer service for U.S. companies



Experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldEdge, or similar field-service software is a major advantage.



Work Schedule



Full-time remote position.



Schedule will generally follow California / Pacific Time business hours.



You must be comfortable working those hours consistently.



Compensation



Starting compensation depends on experience.



Expected range: Depends on experience





Strong performers who demonstrate independence, reliability, excellent customer communication, and the ability to manage projects with minimal supervision can earn more.



Who Will Be Successful in This Position



You may be a good fit if you are the type of person who:



* notices problems before someone points them out;

* likes keeping things organized;

* follows up until an issue is actually resolved;

* is comfortable calling people instead of waiting for
 replies;

* does not forget unfinished tasks;

* takes ownership of responsibilities;

* can communicate professionally with demanding customers;

* stays calm when schedules change;

* can determine what needs to happen next without waiting for detailed instructions.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the team, not someone looking for a temporary side job.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous experience with U.S. customers.

3. Any HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Construction, or Home Services experience.

4. Any experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, or similar software.

5. Your current hourly rate.

6. Your availability during U.S. Pacific Time.

7. A 1–2 minute video recording in English introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this position.



Applications without a video recording may not be considered.

You freeze when a homeowner says "not interested"

You've never been on a US based roofing cold calling campaign.

DM us with a 30-second voice or video message. Tell us who you are, what campaigns you've worked, and why you're the one we should call back.

We don't drag out the process. If you've got it, you'll know fast.

title: Operations Manager | Remote
description:
Operations Manager — Full Time Remote



We’re looking for an Operations Manager to help run the daily operations of a growing online business.



This is not a VA role where you just wait for tasks. We need someone who can take responsibility for things, manage people, keep projects moving, solve problems, and make sure work actually gets done without needing to be chased constantly.



You’ll work directly with the owner and gradually take over more of the daily operations as you prove yourself.





What you’ll be doing:



• Managing remote staff and making sure people are doing what they’re supposed to do

• Helping with recruiting, screening, onboarding and replacing staff when needed

• Turning larger goals into actual tasks, deadlines and plans

• Following up on work and making sure things get finished

• Creating and improving SOPs, trackers and processes

• Coordinating between different team members

• Spotting problems before they become bigger problems

• Handling normal operational issues without immediately escalating everything

• Keeping reporting simple and making sure the important numbers and problems are visible

• Helping us plan ahead when we need more staff, capacity or resources





You won’t be expected to know everything on day one.



What matters more is that when you don’t know something, you can figure it out.





What we’re looking for:



Ideally, you’ve managed people before and have experience in operations, recruiting, remote teams, agencies, digital businesses or something similar.



More importantly, you should be someone who:



• Is organized and follows through

• Can manage people and hold them accountable

• Communicates clearly in English (C2)

• Doesn’t need step by step instructions for everything

• Can prioritize when multiple things are happening at once

• Tries to solve problems before asking someone else what to do

• Knows when to make a decision yourself and when something actually needs to be escalated

• Is comfortable with spreadsheets, trackers, project management tools and learning new software

• Likes improving systems instead of doing the same inefficient thing forever





We care more about whether you can actually run operations than whether you have the perfect resume.





Salary:



Starting salary is $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on your experience and how strong of a fit you are for the role. There will be a formal review after your first 90 days. The 90 day review is based on your actual performance, how much responsibility you’ve been able to take over, how independently you work, and how well you manage the operation. It is not an automatic salary increase after 90 days, but strong performance can lead to higher compensation, bonuses and more responsibility.



If you become someone we can genuinely rely on to run a large part of the operation, there is a lot of room to grow with the company.





Hours:



• Full time

• 40 hours per week

• Remote

• Some flexibility may occasionally be needed if something important comes up





Who this probably isn’t for:



If you need very detailed instructions for every task or prefer being told exactly what to do all day, this probably won’t be a good fit. We’re looking for someone who likes taking ownership, figuring things out, managing people and making things run better.



When applying, start your application with “Operations First” so we know you read the full post.

title: Senior Real Estate & Construction Accountant / Bookkeeper
description:
Do not apply for this job if you plan to have other jobs, and we work EST. You must work on our time zone.



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate development, construction, and investment company looking for an exceptional Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper based in the Philippines.



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We own and operate apartment properties and develop new residential construction projects. Our accounting involves multiple LLCs, construction projects, investors, loans, subcontractors, credit cards, and bank accounts.



We need an experienced professional who can take ownership of the accounting function, not someone who simply enters transactions.



What You'll Handle:



* Accounting for multiple LLCs and properties

* Construction job costing and WIP

* Tracking costs by project, property, vendor, and category

* Accounts payable and subcontractor payments

* Bank and credit card reconciliations

* Construction and real estate loan accounting

* Intercompany loans and transfers

* Owner/investor contributions and distributions

* Rental property income and expenses

* Monthly financial statements

* Budget vs. actual and project cost reporting

* Identifying duplicate payments, errors, and incorrect classifications



Who We're Looking For:



* 5+ years of accounting/bookkeeping experience

* 3+ years working with U.S. companies

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience

* Significant real estate accounting experience

* Significant construction/job-cost accounting experience

* Experience managing multiple entities simultaneously

* Strong understanding of accrual accounting and balance sheets

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Excellent English communication



CPA credentials are helpful but not required. Proven real-world experience is more important.



Experience with 
, 
, GCPay, Procore, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or similar platforms is a plus.



The Person We Want:



We want someone who thinks like an accountant/controller, not a data-entry bookkeeper.



If an account doesn't reconcile, you investigate it. If an invoice looks like a duplicate, you flag it. If a project is over budget, you tell us. If something doesn't make sense, you figure out why.



We are not looking for the cheapest bookkeeper. We are looking for a highly experienced, dependable accounting professional who can become a key member of our company for years to come.



To Apply:



Please send your resume, years of U.S. accounting experience, real estate/construction accounting experience, software experience, and desired monthly salary in USD.



Start your application with the words "PROJECT ACCOUNTING" so we know you read the entire post.

title: Inside Sales Associate (Outbound Caller)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for highly driven and motivated Inside Sales Associate/ Outbound Caller to join our growing team in the business financing industry.



This role is focused on outbound lead generation, qualification, and appointment setting. You will be the first point of contact for potential business clients—guiding them through the application process and connecting qualified prospects with our closing team.



This is a fast-paced, performance-driven opportunity ideal for individuals who are coachable, competitive, confident on the phone, and motivated by high earning potential.



Trial & Recruitment Process (Required for All Applicants)



All candidates are required to complete a 4-day trial process as part of the recruitment and evaluation process. Performance during the trial will determine:

- Your qualification for the role

- Your final job offer

- Your starting hourly rate within our compensation range



Trial Schedule

Day 1:

Training on systems, scripts, objection handling, and live roleplay sessions



Days 2–4:

Live outbound calling using the company dialer



Trial Requirement

To successfully pass the trial, candidates must:

- Secure at least 1 qualified appointment during the live calling days

- A “qualified appointment” is not simply an interested lead

- The lead must be reviewed and approved by management/closers as a legitimate qualified transfer



Trial Outcome

If successful:

- Receive a $50 USD trial payout

- Receive an immediate ISA job offer

- Compensation package will be based on trial performance



If unsuccessful:

- The recruitment process will conclude with no further obligation from either party and $50 will not be paid



Work Schedule

Monday to Thursday only (4-day work week)

8 hours per day

Must be available during U.S. business hours

(10:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT)



Enjoy a 3-day weekend while maintaining strong earning potential.



Key Responsibilities

- Make 250+ outbound calls daily to potential business clients

- Guide prospects through the credit application process

- Collect and organize required documentation: Signed credit application, 6 months of bank statements, Voided check, Valid government-issued ID

- Upload completed files into the company system

- Ensure submissions meet “full package” underwriting requirements

- Transfer qualified clients to a live closer

- Maintain consistent pipeline activity and performance metrics



Compensation Structure (Post-Trial)

- Hourly Rate

- $5–$7 USD/hour (Final rate determined based on trial performance and overall evaluation)

- Commission Structure

$20 per qualified appointment

$50 per closed deal

$50 recurring bonus for repeat deals from your clients



High performers are rewarded based on consistency and results.



We’re Looking For Someone Who Is:

- Fluent in English with clear and neutral communication

- Comfortable working U.S. business hours

- Financially motivated and goal-oriented

- Energetic, confident, and persuasive on calls

- Able to handle high daily call volume

- Sales experience is a plus (training provided)



Why Join Us?

- High earning potential with performance-based rewards

- Fully remote setup

- 4-day work week with 3 days off

- Access to premium sales training

- Clear growth opportunities into senior SDR or closer roles

- Performance-focused environment with uncapped upside



Applicants are required to submit their resume via a shareable link with access granted for review.

title: Inside Sales Representative – Business Funding
description:
About the Role

Are you an experienced, high-energy cold caller who knows how to close business owners on the phone? We are a fast-growing financial firm offering Merchant Cash Advances (MCA), Lines of Credit, and Commercial Mortgages to business owners across the United States.



We are looking for elite Outbound Sales Representatives with fluent, accent-neutral English to generate leads and pre-qualify business owners looking for working capital.



If you have a strong sales drive, want to earn $1,000+ per month, and love the idea of a 3-day weekend every single week, this is the position for you!



Key Benefits

3-Day Weekend Every Week: Work hard Monday through Thursday, then enjoy Friday, Saturday, and Sunday off.



High Earning Potential: Strong performers can easily reach $1,000+ per month combining guaranteed hourly pay with instant payouts on apps and funded deals.



Clear Career Growth: We promote strictly from within. Top performers quickly advance to Senior Broker, Account Executive, or Leadership roles with higher pay.



Support & Systems: We provide dialers, scripts, and high-converting lead lists—you bring the hustle.



What You’ll Do

Conduct high-volume outbound cold calls to US small business owners during US business hours.



Pitch our suite of financial products (MCA, Lines of Credit, Mortgages).



Uncover funding needs and pre-qualify interested business owners.



Collect merchant applications ($20 payout per valid app).



Hand off warm, qualified deals to our closing team ($50 bonus per deal funded).



Requirements

Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven experience in outbound sales, cold calling, or B2B phone sales (experience in MCA, business loans, or mortgages is highly preferred).



Language Skills: Perfect, fluent English (native or near-native level) with excellent tone, confidence, and conversational skills.



US Schedule: Must be able to work full US business hours (EST/PST) Monday through Thursday.



Sales Mindset: High energy, resilient, and motivated to hit and exceed monthly financial targets.



Tech Requirements: Dedicated, quiet home office, high-speed internet (20+ Mbps), and a noise-canceling USB headset.

title: Lead Video Editor (Highly Advanced Premiere Pro)
description:
Company: PCB Films

Job Type: Part-time (Adjust as needed)

Location: Remote 



About PCB Films

At PCB Films, we produce high-end, cinematic video content that elevates brands, captures luxury real estate, and tells compelling stories. Based along the stunning Emerald Coast, we work with top-tier real estate agents, custom builders, business leaders, and creators to deliver visually striking and highly engaging media.



We are looking for a Highly Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro Editor to join our team and take our post-production to the next level.



The Role

We need a creative, detail-oriented storyteller who understands pacing, retention, and aesthetic. You will be responsible for editing a wide variety of high-quality content, seamlessly shifting from a dynamic luxury home tour to a polished, multicam podcast episode. You must have an expert-level command of Adobe Premiere Pro and a sharp eye for color grading, audio sweetening, and modern motion graphics.



Check out the caliber of work we expect by viewing our portfolio here: 



Key Responsibilities

- Luxury Real Estate Videos: Craft cinematic, smooth, and engaging property tours that highlight high-end architectural details and lifestyle elements.

- Multicam Podcasts: Sync, cut, and polish multicam podcast episodes, ensuring perfect audio clarity, camera switching, and engaging pacing.

- Longform Interviews & Documentaries: Edit talking-head interviews and documentary-style branded content, building strong narratives using A-roll and B-roll effectively.

- Short-Form Content (Shorts/Reels/TikToks): Repurpose longform content into high-retention, viral-style vertical clips with dynamic captions, pacing, and sound design.

- Color & Audio: Perform professional color correction/grading (Lumetri) and audio sweetening to ensure a flawless final product.

- Asset Management: Organize project files, maintain a clean timeline, and efficiently manage media assets.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Expert-Level Adobe Premiere Pro: You must be highly advanced in Premiere Pro. (Knowledge of After Effects for motion graphics and Audition for audio is a strong plus).

- Multicam Mastery: Extensive experience setting up and editing multicam sequences efficiently.

- Pacing & Storytelling: A proven ability to keep viewers engaged, whether it is a fast-paced social short or a 45-minute interview.

- Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of frame rates, aspect ratios, export settings, color spaces, and proxy workflows.

- Self-Starter: Ability to take raw footage and a creative brief and run with it, delivering polished drafts with minimal hand-holding.

- Portfolio: A strong demo reel or portfolio showcasing exactly the types of content listed above.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

title: Video Editing & AI Content Creation
description:
We are looking for a skilled AI content creator and video editor to produce high-retention, satisfying short-form transformation videos from start to finish. 



We will provide the core concept/topic for each video. You will handle the entire production pipeline: generating the AI video clips, sequencing the story, editing, and adding realistic ASMR sound design.



---



THE REQUIRED CREATION PROCESS:

Each 35–45 second video must strictly follow a structured, fast-paced sequence:

1. Hook & Inspection (0–8s): Opening on a raw, ruined, or extreme subject, followed by close inspection using precision tools.

2. Teardown & Process (8–30s): Generating rapid, multi-angle AI transformation steps (cleaning, scraping, rebuilding, chemical mixing, precision crafting) while maintaining strict visual continuity of the object and setting.

3. Build & Final Reveal (30–45s): Reassembling the final piece, finishing with a dramatic beauty reveal and a quick split/flash before-and-after comparison.

4. Audio & Polish: Cutting tightly on action (new visual reset every 2–3 seconds) and syncing rich, immersive ASMR/foley sound effects to every physical movement.



---



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Generate high-quality, high-consistency video clips using AI generation tools.

- Edit and assemble the final 35–45s vertical video (1080x1920).

- Layer realistic sound effects (foley/ASMR) and subtle background audio.

- Deliver a finished, ready-to-use MP4 file.



---



REQUIREMENTS:

- Proven experience with generative AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, Luma, Kling, Pika, Higgsfield, or equivalent).

- Strong video editing skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut).

- Excellent sense of pacing and sound design (audio must feel physically real, not hollow).

- Strong attention to visual continuity (keeping objects and hands consistent across prompts).

- Fast, reliable turnaround.



---



NEXT STEPS:

We will select the top applicants for a single PAID test video. If the quality, pacing, and turnaround meet our standard, this will immediately convert into regular, ongoing bulk batches.



---



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THE FOLLOWING:

1. What AI video/image generation tools and editing software do you currently use?

2. How long does it typically take you to produce one complete 40-second video (generation + editing + sound design)?

3. What is your rate for a single 40-second test video, and what would your rate be for batches (e.g., 5–10 videos)?

4. Please share 2–3 links to short-form videos you have created or edited that showcase your AI generation or pacing/sound design skills.

5. Put the word "PROCESS" at the very top of your application so we know you read the full brief.

description:
ABOUT ZOIS



ZOIS is a Swiss luxury fragrance house. We produce extrait-concentration perfumes in Switzerland and sell them direct-to-consumer, no retailers, no middlemen, no department stores.



We launched in 2025, scaled to seven figures across Switzerland and Germany, and recently entered the US market. We're a small, fast-moving team that ships a lot of creative.



Here's the important part: we sell through video. Our ads are the business. Every euro of revenue starts with someone stopping their scroll. That's why this role matters more here than it would at most companies and why we pay for performance instead of for hours.



THE ROLE



You'll edit direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, VSL-style ads, UGC edits, testimonial cuts, product creatives.



Full-time, long-term, remote. You'll get briefs, scripts, b-roll libraries and reaction footage from our creative team. Your job is to turn them into ads that sell.



Before you apply, look at what we actually run. This is our live ad library, sorted by impressions, the top ads are our winners. That's the standard you're editing to:





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Editing skill. Pacing, hook retention, cuts that hold attention, clean subtitles, sound design that doesn't feel like a template.

Fast communication. You reply within hours during working hours. No disappearing.

Few feedback loops. Your first version should be close to final. We don't want to art-direct every cut.

Team player. You take direction well and you're easy to work with.

You think ahead. You suggest better hooks, flag weak sections, notice when a script section drags. We want an editor with an opinion, not a button-pusher.

Direct response understanding. Hook ? problem ? mechanism ? proof ? offer ? CTA. You don't need to be an expert, we teach a lot in-house, but you need to care about why an ad converts, not just how it looks.



Tools are up to you (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci). We care about output, not software.



COMPENSATION



$1,000/month base, full-time

$50 bonus per performing video, every creative that hits our performance benchmark

Our editors who produce winners consistently add several hundred dollars per month on top of base. There is real upside here. If your creatives scale, you earn more.

Script to edit:

-------

Wait a minute… why can't women resist this cologne?

I'm 46. And somewhere in the last ten years, I turned into furniture.

Nobody says it out loud. You just feel it. The elevator. The bar. The table next to yours. You're the guy nobody turns around for.

It's not that I stopped trying. It's that I stopped expecting anything to happen when I walked into a room.

Then a friend put a bottle of ZOIS on my desk. I thought: it's cologne. What's it going to do. That was the first thing I got wrong.

Most of what you find in a department store is around 8% fragrance oil. Two hours, gone. ZOIS is built at extrait concentration, the same oil load houses charge four hundred dollars for. It doesn't sit on your skin. It moves ahead of you. People smell you before they see you.

Week one, the woman at the counter leaned in. Week two, someone stopped me mid-sentence and asked what I was wearing. Three words I hadn't heard in eleven years.

It's not magic. It's not pheromones. Nothing in a bottle changes who you are. It just gives people a reason to pause. And when they pause, you get to be seen.

ZOIS, If nobody says a word,send it back. We'll refund it.

title: HR & Payroll Manager - U.S. Trucking Company (ADP, Employee Relations)
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We are hiring one person to BE our HR department. You will own HR and payroll for a U.S. trucking company based in Savannah, Georgia, and our employees and drivers will contact you directly when they have a problem. You will not be assisting someone who does HR. You will be the person who does HR.



THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL ASSISTANT ROLE. If you are looking for admin work, data entry, or a general VA position, this is not it and we will not be a good fit.



WHAT THE JOB ACTUALLY IS



A W-2 truck driver calls you and says: "My paycheck is short. I'm missing eight hours and my $150 safety bonus."



What happens next is the job. You listen. You get his pay period and details. You pull the payroll and time records. You find the discrepancy. You coordinate with operations if you need source information. You determine the correction, get the approval it requires, process it, call him back and explain it plainly, document the case, and close it.



You own that problem from the moment you answer the phone until it is resolved. You do not forward it to the owner. That is the entire reason this position exists.



ENGLISH REQUIREMENT - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Exceptional spoken and written English is a NON-NEGOTIABLE requirement for this position. It is not a preference. If your spoken English is not strong, please do not apply - you will not pass our assessment and we will both have wasted our time.



You will speak by telephone every day with American CDL drivers, dispatchers, office staff, managers, job applicants, ADP representatives, and benefits providers. Some of those calls will be from people who are frustrated and believe they have been underpaid. You need to handle those conversations calmly and confidently.



Specifically, you must be able to:

- Understand conversational American English, including different regional accents and people speaking quickly

- Be easily understood by American employees over the telephone, including on poor connections and from inside a truck

- Think and respond naturally in real time - this role cannot be done from a script

- Ask intelligent follow-up questions and lead a difficult conversation

- Explain a payroll calculation clearly to someone who is upset

- De-escalate professionally without becoming defensive or over-apologizing

- Write professional business
s with excellent grammar and spelling

- Document conversations accurately and objectively



We do NOT screen on accent. We screen on clarity, comprehension, fluency, professionalism, and confidence. All shortlisted candidates complete a voice recording and a live English conversation before any offer is made.



PAYROLL RESPONSIBILITIES



We run W-2 payroll through ADP. You will be responsible for:

- Preparing and running payroll in ADP

- Payroll auditing and pre-submission review

- Answering employee and driver payroll questions

- Investigating incorrect pay and missing hours

- Verifying bonuses and incentives

- Deductions and payroll corrections

- PTO and benefits coordination with payroll

- Payroll reporting and records

- Multi-state payroll administration

- Payroll case management

- Communicating resolutions back to employees



A NOTE ON INTERNAL CONTROLS: payroll preparation and payroll approval are separate functions here. You will prepare, audit and recommend; final release is approved by ownership. If you are looking for a role with unrestricted authority to create and approve payments, this is not that role - and any experienced payroll professional will understand why.



AN IMPORTANT DISTINCTION ABOUT OUR WORKFORCE



We have W-2 employees and drivers, who are paid through ADP - and separately we work with owner-operators and independent contractors, who are NOT employees and are NOT paid through ADP. Owner-operator payments run through driver settlements, which is a specialized trucking accounting function.



You may help route or coordinate owner-operator payment questions, but settlements are not your core responsibility and we may hire a separate Driver Settlements Specialist. If you have trucking settlement experience, tell us - it counts in your favor. It is not required.



HR RESPONSIBILITIES



Day-to-day HR operations, employee relations and employee support, employee handbook and HR policy administration, personnel records and HR documentation, performance management administration, corrective action and disciplinary documentation, employee complaints, leave and PTO administration, benefits administration and coordination, HRIS administration, multi-state HR compliance administration, HR reporting, employment verification, offboarding and termination administration, and maintaining confidential employee records.



You are NOT expected to provide U.S. legal advice. We expect you to know when a situation needs to go to U.S.-based HR leadership, an HR consultant, employment counsel, or ownership - and to escalate it promptly and with good documentation. Knowing where your authority ends is part of the job.



RECRUITING AND ONBOARDING



Recruiting: CDL driver, dispatcher and office recruiting, sourcing, applicant screening, initial interviews, scheduling, candidate follow-up, pipeline management, offer coordination, recruiting reports and KPIs. Experience recruiting for U.S. trucking or logistics companies is strongly preferred.



Onboarding: employee onboarding and ADP onboarding, new-hire paperwork and document collection, orientation coordination, background check coordination, employment verification, personnel file setup, training coordination, certification and license tracking, new-hire follow-up, offboarding.



TRAINING AND PERFORMANCE



Coordinating recurring employee training and training records, certification tracking, performance tracking and employee scorecards, performance improvement documentation, incentive programs, employee retention initiatives, and management development coordination.



THIS IS AN HR ROLE, NOT A DOT SAFETY ROLE



Please read this carefully, because it matters. This position is NOT our DOT Safety Director.



You may administratively assist with CDL and medical card expiration tracking, training records, certification reminders, and driver onboarding documentation. However, qualified safety and compliance personnel retain responsibility for Driver Qualification Files, the FMCSA Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse, DOT drug and alcohol compliance, MVR monitoring, Hours of Service, ELD compliance, a
 management, DOT audits, FMCSA regulatory interpretation, and driver safety qualification decisions.



You will work closely with Safety. We do not want you representing yourself as a DOT compliance expert unless you genuinely are one.



WORKING HOURS



9:00 AM - 6:00 PM U.S. EASTERN TIME, Monday through Friday.



IN THE PHILIPPINES THIS IS 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM MANILA TIME.



Please be certain you can sustain this schedule before applying. On November 1 the United States leaves daylight saving time and your hours become 10:00 PM - 7:00 AM Manila. Your contract is anchored to Eastern Time.



Reliability and punctuality are critical. Our employees and drivers need HR and payroll assistance during U.S. operating hours.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Approximately 5+ years of professional HR and/or payroll experience

- Hands-on U.S. payroll experience - you have actually processed U.S. payroll, not observed it

- Exceptional spoken and written English - verified by voice recording and live conversation. Non-negotiable.

- Direct employee-facing experience - you have handled employee questions and complaints yourself, by phone

- Ability to work 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila), Monday to Friday, reliably

- Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets ability

- Demonstrated discretion with confidential information

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet working environment, and a headset suitable for professional calls

- Willingness to use multi-factor authentication and follow company security procedures



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Hands-on ADP experience, especially ADP Workforce Now. This is the single strongest preference we have.

- U.S. multi-state payroll experience

- U.S. trucking, logistics, or transportation experience

- CDL driver recruiting experience

- Benefits administration experience

- HRIS administration experience

- High-volume or field-workforce HR experience

- Prior remote HR support for a U.S. company

- Trucking settlement exposure (a genuine plus, not a requirement)



If you have excellent U.S. HR, payroll and ADP experience but no trucking background, please still apply. We can teach trucking terminology. We cannot teach judgment or telephone presence.



WHO DOES WELL HERE



Professional and mature. Highly organized. Confident but empathetic. Firm when required. Detail-oriented. Accountable. Discreet. Calm under pressure. A genuine problem-solver. Proactive. Comfortable making decisions inside defined authority and escalating outside it. Excellent at follow-through.



Who does NOT do well here: anyone who needs to be chased to finish routine work, or who is more comfortable forwarding a problem than owning it.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



This is a senior position and it is compensated as one. We set pay based on experience and on how you perform in our assessments - not on who will accept the least. We would rather pay properly once and keep someone for years than replace a cheap hire every eight months.



Please tell us your expected monthly rate when you apply. If you are the right person, we will have a serious conversation about it.



In addition to salary, this position includes:

- 13th month pay

- HMO / health allowance

- Internet allowance

- Paid time off - 15 days annually, increasing with tenure

- Philippine holidays

- U.S. holidays when our office is closed

- Company-provided equipment

- Quarterly performance bonus tied to clear KPIs

- Annual salary review



SECURITY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



This role has access to employee records, Social Security numbers, payroll and banking information, benefits data, W-2s and personnel files. Access is role-based and monitored. Multi-factor authentication and our security procedures are mandatory. We take this seriously and you must too.



HOW TO APPLY



THE FIRST LINE OF YOUR APPLICATION MUST CONTAIN THESE THREE THINGS, IN THIS ORDER, SEPARATED BY DASHES:



[Years of hands-on U.S. payroll experience] - [Payroll platform you know best] - [Your expected monthly rate in USD]



Example: 6 years - ADP Workforce Now - $2,300



Applications that do not begin this way will not be reviewed. This is not a trick - we need those three facts immediately, and it tells us you read the posting before applying.



Then please provide all of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

3. A 2-3 minute voice recording (instructions below)

4. A description of your U.S. payroll experience - which companies, how many employees per pay period, which states

5. A description of your ADP experience - which ADP product, what you did inside it, for how long

6. A description of your U.S. HR experience

7. A description of your employee relations experience, including one difficult situation you handled directly

8. Your trucking or logistics experience, if any. If none, say so plainly - it will not disqualify you.

9. Your internet speed (download and upload - run a speed test and give us the actual numbers)

10. Your computer specifications (processor, RAM, operating system)

11. Confirmation you can work 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila), Monday to Friday

12. Your expected monthly compensation in USD



VOICE RECORDING INSTRUCTIONS



Record 2-3 minutes of audio. Your phone is fine, but find a quiet room. Speak naturally. Please do NOT read from a script - we can hear it, and it tells us nothing about how you will sound on a live call. Cover these four things:



1. Introduce yourself and summarize your payroll and HR background in about 30 seconds.

2. Describe the payroll system you know best and one specific problem you solved inside it.

3. Describe a time an employee came to you upset about their pay. What did they say, what did you do, and how did it end?

4. Explain, as if you were speaking to a truck driver on the phone, why his paycheck was $150 lower than he expected because a safety bonus was not approved in time for that pay period.



Item 4 is the one that matters most to us. Upload the file and include the link.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



1. Application review

2. Voice recording review

3. Paid written assessment (payroll reconciliation and written English - we pay for your time whether or not we hire you)

4. Live English conversation and driver role-play

5. ADP and payroll technical interview

6. Reference checks

7. Offer



We move quickly for strong candidates and we tell you either way. You will not be left waiting without an answer.

title: GoHighLevel Specialist with Paid Ads Experience

title: Property Acquisition Virtual Assistant / Real Estate Investment Cold Caller
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company seeking a professional, reliable, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help identify homeowners who may be interested in selling their property directly to our investment company.



This is NOT a real estate agent or brokerage position. Our company is seeking to purchase properties for its own investment purposes and portfolio.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved calling systems. Your goal is to determine whether a homeowner may be interested in discussing a potential direct sale of their property to our investment company.



You are the first voice homeowners will hear from our company, so we are looking for someone who sounds professional, confident, friendly, and natural.



This is NOT a script-reading robot position. You should be able to listen, build rapport, ask appropriate questions, handle rejection professionally, and have a genuine conversation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved systems.



• Follow company-approved scripts, calling procedures, calling hours, and compliance requirements.



• Clearly and truthfully identify yourself and the investment company you are calling on behalf of.



• Ask property owners whether they would consider selling their property directly to our investment company.



• Have friendly and professional conversations with homeowners.



• Identify homeowners who have a genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Gather approved basic information from interested homeowners, such as property condition, occupancy, motivation for potentially selling, expected timeline, and whether the homeowner has a price in mind.



• Accurately document calls, conversations, notes, follow-ups, and outcomes in our CRM.



• Categorize leads based on the homeowner's level of interest.



• Schedule a follow-up conversation with the company owner when a homeowner expresses genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Conduct approved follow-up calls when instructed.



• Immediately document any request from a homeowner not to receive additional calls and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



• Provide regular reporting regarding calls, conversations, interested property owners, follow-ups, and CRM activity.



IMPORTANT — REAL ESTATE LICENSING COMPLIANCE



This position is for a real estate investment company seeking to acquire properties for its OWN account and investment portfolio.



This is NOT a real estate brokerage position.



Although the owner of the investment company may separately hold a New Jersey real estate license, this position is for the property investment/acquisition business and NOT for soliciting brokerage clients or real estate listings.



The Virtual Assistant must follow all company policies designed to comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including applicable New Jersey Real Estate Commission requirements.



YOU WILL NOT:



• Represent yourself as a real estate agent, Realtor®, broker, attorney, appraiser, or other licensed professional.



• Solicit homeowners to list their property with a real estate agent or brokerage.



• Solicit listing agreements or brokerage relationships.



• Offer brokerage or real estate representation services.



• Represent third-party buyers or sellers.



• Provide legal, tax, financing, appraisal, brokerage, or real estate advice.



• Provide an appraisal, CMA, or opinion regarding property value.



• Negotiate the purchase or sale of real estate.



• Make binding purchase offers or agree to purchase prices or other material contract terms on behalf of the company.



• Prepare, modify, interpret, explain, or execute real estate contracts.



• Discuss real estate commissions or brokerage compensation.



• Perform activities requiring a real estate license unless properly licensed and specifically authorized.



When a homeowner expresses genuine interest in potentially selling, your responsibility is to gather the approved information, accurately document the lead, and refer the homeowner to the company owner for further discussion.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on a U.S. phone call.



• Strong communication and listening skills.



• Previous outbound cold-calling experience strongly preferred.



• Experience calling U.S. homeowners strongly preferred.



• Previous U.S. real estate investment cold-calling experience is a major plus.



• Comfortable with rejection and high call volume.



• Able to have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script.



• Friendly and professional without being aggressive or misleading.



• Organized and disciplined with CRM data entry and follow-up.



• Reliable and punctual.



• Quiet home workspace.



• Quality headset and microphone.



• Reliable high-speed internet connection.



• Backup internet connection strongly preferred.



• Reliable computer capable of operating web-based CRM and calling software.



• Spanish-speaking ability is a plus but NOT required.



TOOLS & TRAINING



The company will provide or designate the approved:



• Lead lists

• Calling/dialer system

• Calling scripts

• CRM

• Training

• Lead qualification procedures

• Calling and compliance procedures



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be evaluated based on:



• Consistent outbound calling activity

• Number and quality of live homeowner conversations

• Qualified/interested property-owner leads generated

• Follow-up completion

• CRM accuracy

• Reliability and attendance

• Professional communication

• Compliance with company procedures



100% CRM documentation and compliance with company calling procedures are expected.



The first 30 days will be a PAID TRIAL PERIOD. Strong performance can lead to a long-term position, additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation reviews as the company grows.



COMPLIANCE — READ CAREFULLY



All outbound calling must be conducted using company-approved lead lists, systems, scripts, calling hours, and procedures.



The VA may not independently purchase, import, source, or begin calling their own lists unless specifically authorized by the company.



The VA must never misrepresent their identity, the company they represent, the purpose of the call, their licensing status, or their authority.



If someone asks not to receive additional calls, the VA must immediately document the request and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



The VA must follow all company policies regarding applicable Do-Not-Call requirements, telephone solicitation requirements, calling restrictions, privacy, caller identification, and recordkeeping.



Compliance is a condition of employment. Failure to follow company procedures may result in immediate termination.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not include ALL of the following may not be reviewed.



1. Send a short message explaining:



• Why you are good on the phone

• Your previous cold-calling experience

• Whether you have called U.S. homeowners

• Whether you have worked for a U.S. real estate investor

• Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day

• Which dialers and CRMs you have used

• Your desired hourly rate

• Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time



2. Submit a 60–90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING role-playing this scenario:



You are calling a homeowner on behalf of our real estate investment company because our company is interested in purchasing properties in their area.



The homeowner says:



“I wasn't really planning on selling, but I guess I'd consider it if the price made sense.”



Continue the conversation naturally.



Your objective is to determine whether the homeowner is genuinely interested and gather appropriate basic information. Do NOT negotiate a purchase price, make an offer, provide a property valuation, or provide real estate advice.



3. Send your resume and briefly describe the best cold-calling or lead-generation results you have personally achieved.



IMPORTANT:



Begin your application with the words:



“PROPERTY INVESTMENT”



This lets us know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and can grow with our real estate investment company.

title: Senior Growth Product Lead (Hunting + P&L)| Work directly with the founder
description:
I run an international e-commerce group. We source in China, we manufacture our own cosmetics, and we sell DTC brands in Europe, the US and the Gulf. I'm opening a product cell and I'm hiring its first senior member. You would be employee #1 of this cell. The hunters we recruit after you will report to you.



Here's the honest version of the job.



Every day, products are blowing up somewhere: an ad that's been scaling for 12 days on Meta US, a TikTok Shop product doing crazy GMV that nobody runs in Europe yet. Your job is to catch these signals early, then do what almost nobody in this market does: open the spreadsheet. Landed cost, margin (we don't launch under 4x), realistic CAC against the AOV, demand checked outside the ad platform. Then you bring me ONE product a day maximum with a clear GO, and you kill the rest in writing. I make the final call, but your judgment is what I'm paying for.



What I need you to already have:



3 to 5+ years in DTC or dropshipping where you did BOTH sides. Maybe you ran your own store with your own money. Maybe you were the media buyer who also picked the products. What matters is that you've chosen products AND lived with their numbers afterwards.



You use spy tools daily. WinningHunter, PiPiAds, Kalodata, Minea, whatever your stack is, you'll show it to me live on screen share during the interview. Yes, live. If that sentence makes you uncomfortable, don't apply.



You have a graveyard. Products you refused to launch, campaigns you killed while the metrics still looked pretty. If you can't name one, you've never really d
 anything.



Excel or Sheets at the level where you BUILD the unit economics model, not fill in someone else's.



What you get: weekly pay, a real seat (your calls go straight to me, no layers), and a team that will grow under you if you're as good as your application says. We start with a paid test mission of 2 to 3 days. Real products, real money, real decision at the end. We're a business in launch mode: if you're good, you'll know within a week, not after 4 rounds of interviews.



**HOW TO APPLY. Read this part twice.**



Generic applications get deleted without being read. Start your message with the word OPERATOR, then answer these 3 questions and nothing else:



1. One product you spotted early and pushed to launch: what was the first signal, and what were the numbers that made it a GO?

2. One product with beautiful ad metrics that you still killed: what did the spreadsheet say that the ads didn't?

3. Your spy tool stack + 2 or 3 time slots this week for an online interview (PH time).



Sharp answers get an interview within 24 hours. I'm hiring now, not next month.

title: Social Media Content Creator & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Home Services / Restoration Company | Long-Term Opportunity



Company: Xpress Restoration Inc.

Location: San Diego County, California

Position: Part-Time, with opportunity to grow

Work Type: Remote



About Us



Xpress Restoration Inc. is an established property restoration company serving homeowners and businesses throughout San Diego County.



We specialize in water damage restoration, fire damage restoration, mold remediation, reconstruction, contents/packout services, and related restoration work.



Our crews document our projects extensively with photos, videos, 360-degree scans, and 3D property documentation.



We already have the content. We need the right person to turn it into stories.



We are looking for a creative and dependable Social Media Content Creator & Short-Form Video Editor who can review our existing project photos and videos, identify interesting content opportunities, and turn them into professional social media content that showcases our work and builds trust with our local community.



What You’ll Be Doing



A major part of this position will be reviewing photos and videos from current and past restoration projects.



You will look for opportunities to tell stories such as:



* Before and after transformations

* Water damage restoration projects

* Emergency mitigation work

* Drying equipment and job-site setups

* Demolition and restoration progress

* Reconstruction projects

* Completed repairs

* Fire and smoke restoration

* Mold remediation projects

* Contents and packout work

* Customer testimonials

* Team and behind-the-scenes content

* Educational homeowner content using real projects



You will then turn those assets into content for platforms such as Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Your Responsibilities



You will help us:



* Review project photos and videos from our existing job files

* Identify projects that would make good social media content

* Select the strongest photos and video clips

* Create engaging short-form Reels and videos

* Create before-and-after videos and graphics

* Create photo carousels and other visual posts

* Edit customer testimonial videos

* Add professional text overlays, captions, transitions, music, and branding

* Write natural, professional social media captions

* Develop strong hooks for short-form videos

* Repurpose one project into multiple pieces of content when appropriate

* Organize selected content so we know what has already been used

* Help maintain a consistent content calendar

* Schedule approved content

* Monitor basic content performance and identify what types of posts are working



Our goal is not to create flashy influencer content.



We want clean, professional, authentic content that shows real work, demonstrates our expertise, and helps homeowners trust our company.



Systems We Use



Our project documentation may come from:



* DASH by Next Gear Solutions

* DocuSketch

* Matterport

* Google Drive or other shared folders



Experience with DASH, DocuSketch, or Matterport is not required.



We can teach you how we use these systems.



Experience with the following is preferred:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Meta Business Suite

* Instagram Reels

*

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

* Google Drive

* ChatGPT or similar AI tools for content assistance



Other professional video editing software is welcome.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is both creative and self-directed.



Eventually, we do not want to have to tell you:



“Use these five pictures and make this exact Reel.”



We want someone who can review a completed project and recognize:



“This would make a great before-and-after video.”



Then take the initiative to develop the idea.



The ideal person:



* Has strong short-form video editing skills

* Has a good eye for visual storytelling

* Understands pacing, hooks, text overlays, and music

* Can turn ordinary job-site photos into interesting content

* Understands before-and-after storytelling

* Writes strong English captions

* Can follow brand guidelines

* Is organized and dependable

* Can work independently after learning our business

* Is comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Understands that quality and trust are more important than chasing viral views

* Wants a long-term opportunity with a growing company



Experience creating content for home services, construction, restoration, remodeling, real estate, roofing, plumbing, HVAC, cleaning, or other local service businesses is a major plus.



Privacy and Professionalism



Our project systems contain private customer and property information.



The person selected for this position must take confidentiality seriously.



Customer names, addresses, insurance information, claim information, internal notes, personal documents, and other private information must never be included in public-facing content unless specifically authorized.



We will provide guidelines regarding what information may and may not be used.



Schedule



We expect to begin part-time, approximately 10 to 20 hours per week.



We care more about consistent, high-quality output than simply logging hours.



For the right person, this position has the opportunity to grow in hours and responsibility over time.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience, portfolio quality, editing ability, and the level of independence you can bring to the position.



We plan to begin finalists with a small paid trial project before making a longer-term commitment.



If the relationship works well, our goal is to develop a consistent, long-term working relationship.



How to Apply



Please send us the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A link to your portfolio.

3. Three examples of short-form videos or Reels that YOU personally edited.

4. If available, send an example where you took raw photos or videos and turned them into finished social media content.

5. Tell us which editing programs you use regularly.

6. Tell us approximately how long it normally takes you to create a professional 20 to 45-second Reel when the photos and video clips are already provided.

7. Tell us about any experience you have creating content for home-service companies, contractors, real estate, construction, or similar businesses.

8. Tell us your desired hourly rate in USD and how many hours per week you are currently available.



Important Application Instruction



Please begin your application with the words:



“I FOUND THE STORY”



Then, in 2 to 3 sentences, tell us what you think makes a good before-and-after Reel interesting to someone who does not already follow the company.



Applications that do not include this will not be prioritized.



Paid Trial



Candidates who appear to be a strong fit may be invited to complete a small paid trial.



We will provide real photos and/or video from one of our restoration projects.



The trial may involve:



* Reviewing the provided project content

* Creating one short-form Reel

* Writing the accompanying caption

* Explaining briefly why you chose that particular approach



We are not looking for perfection.



We want to see your creativity, editing ability, judgment, storytelling, communication, and ability to work with real-world content.



If you’re someone who enjoys taking a folder full of ordinary project photos and turning it into content that makes people stop and say, “Wow, look at that transformation,” we’d like to hear from you.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description:
Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them.



That looks like:



Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself

Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand

Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news

Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role



Nice to Have



API integration experience

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running

Your documentation is already being used by others



At 6 months:



Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions

You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked



At 12 months:



The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again



How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.



There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a detailed task list to know what to work on

You build something once and consider it done

You document only when asked

You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions



There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment
