title: Experienced Xactimate Restoration Estimator | Water, Fire, Mold & Packouts
description:
Experienced Xactimate Restoration Estimator | Water, Fire, Mold & Packouts



Type of Work: Part-Time / Project-Based

Hours: TBD based on workload

Pay: $8-$12/hour based on experience. Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate.



About the Role



We are an established U.S.-based restoration company looking for a highly experienced Xactimate Restoration Estimator to work remotely alongside our Project Managers and operations team.



Our company handles multiple types of restoration projects, including:



* Water damage mitigation

* Water damage repairs/reconstruction

* Fire and smoke damage repairs/reconstruction

* Mold remediation

* Contents and packout projects



Our largest volume of work is water damage mitigation and reconstruction, so strong experience in water damage estimating is especially important. However, the ideal candidate will be capable of estimating across multiple restoration divisions.



Experience preparing fire damage repair estimates is a major plus.



This is not an entry-level Xactimate position and not a data-entry position.



We are looking for someone who already understands Xactimate, insurance restoration, construction, estimating, supplements, and job profitability.



We will train you on our company’s specific procedures and systems, but we are not looking to train someone how to use Xactimate or how to write restoration estimates.



You should be capable of receiving job documentation and independently developing a detailed, accurate, and defensible estimate with minimal supervision.



Primary Responsibilities



Repair & Reconstruction Estimating



Our primary need is someone who can prepare detailed and complete repair estimates.



Responsibilities include:



* Prepare Xactimate repair/reconstruction estimates for water damage projects.

* Prepare fire and smoke damage repair/reconstruction estimates when applicable.

* Review photos, videos, measurements, sketches, scope notes, DocuSketch, Matterport, and other project documentation.

* Identify legitimate missing scope items.

* Use appropriate Xactimate line items, quantities, labor, materials, equipment, and supporting documentation.

* Prepare estimates that accurately reflect the work necessary to complete the project.

* Review insurance carrier estimates and identify legitimate differences in scope.

* Prepare detailed supplements with appropriate supporting documentation.

* Revise estimates when additional information, hidden conditions, or legitimate scope changes are identified.

* Communicate missing information or questions to the Project Manager before completing an estimate.



Water Mitigation Estimating



You should understand water mitigation and be capable of preparing detailed mitigation estimates.



Responsibilities may include:



* Prepare Xactimate estimates for emergency water mitigation projects.

* Review drying documentation, photos, equipment logs, moisture documentation, and job notes.

* Estimate demolition and removal of affected materials.

* Estimate drying equipment and monitoring.

* Estimate containment, cleaning, antimicrobial applications, and other applicable mitigation procedures.

* Identify missing or unsupported mitigation line items.

* Understand the difference between mitigation and reconstruction scopes.



Fire & Smoke Damage Estimating



Fire estimating experience is highly desirable.



Candidates with fire restoration experience should understand how to prepare repair estimates involving items such as:



* Fire-damaged building materials

* Smoke and soot damage

* Demolition

* Cleaning

* Sealing

* Painting

* Structural repairs

* Finish repairs

* Specialty restoration procedures

* Reconstruction following fire damage



If you have significant experience estimating larger fire losses, please explain this in your application.



Mold Remediation Estimating



The ideal candidate should also have experience preparing estimates for mold remediation projects.



This may include:



* Containment

* Negative air

* Air filtration devices

* PPE

* Controlled demolition

* Cleaning

* HEPA vacuuming

* Antimicrobial applications

* Equipment

* Labor

* Disposal

* Other appropriate remediation procedures



You should understand how mold remediation scopes differ from standard water mitigation and reconstruction.



Contents & Packout Estimating



Experience preparing packout and contents estimates is also preferred.



Responsibilities may include estimating:



* Contents manipulation

* Packing

* Boxes and packing materials

* Inventory

* Labor

* Transportation

* Storage

* Cleaning

* Pack-back

* Other applicable contents-related work



Subcontractor Scopes & Job Budgets



This is a very important part of the position.



We do not want someone who only writes an estimate and moves on to the next file.



For repair/reconstruction projects, you will help our Project Managers convert approved Xactimate estimates into an executable and profitable production plan.



Once an estimate is approved, you may be responsible for:



* Reviewing the approved Xactimate estimate.

* Breaking the approved scope down by construction trade.

* Preparing clear subcontractor scopes of work.

* Separating applicable Xactimate line items by subcontractor or trade.

* Helping establish budgets for each trade based on the approved project estimate.

* Helping the Project Manager understand the available budget for each portion of the project.

* Identifying potential scope, cost, or profitability problems before work is assigned.

* Making sure subcontractor scopes clearly identify what work each trade is responsible for.

* Working alongside the Project Manager throughout the reconstruction process.



Trades may include:



* Demolition

* Framing

* Drywall

* Texture

* Painting

* Flooring

* Tile

* Cabinets

* Countertops

* Finish carpentry

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* HVAC

* Roofing

* Cleaning

* Other applicable construction trades



You should understand that a good estimate needs to work both on paper and in the real world.



Required Experience



Please do not apply if you need to be trained on Xactimate or basic restoration estimating.



We are looking for candidates with:



* Minimum 2 years of hands-on professional Xactimate estimating experience.

* Strong experience preparing insurance restoration estimates.

* Strong experience preparing water damage repair/reconstruction estimates.

* Experience preparing water mitigation estimates.

* Experience preparing Xactimate supplements.

* Strong understanding of construction and reconstruction.

* Ability to interpret photos, videos, sketches, measurements, scopes, and 3D documentation.

* Ability to develop detailed scopes independently without extensive hand-holding.

* Strong understanding of Xactimate line items and restoration estimating practices.

* Ability to identify legitimate missing scope.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good written English and communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with Project Managers.



Strongly Preferred



The ideal candidate will also have:



* Experience preparing fire and smoke damage repair/reconstruction estimates.

* Experience preparing mold remediation estimates.

* Experience preparing contents and packout estimates.

* Previous experience working directly for a restoration contractor.

* Experience working with U.S. insurance restoration claims.

* Experience reviewing insurance carrier estimates.

* Experience preparing and documenting supplements.

* Experience creating subcontractor scopes from approved Xactimate estimates.

* Experience separating reconstruction estimates by trade.

* Understanding of job costing, gross profit, and construction budgets.

* Experience working directly with reconstruction Project Managers.

* Experience with DocuSketch and/or Matterport.

* Experience with DASH by Next Gear Solutions.

* Experience with XactAnalysis.

* Previous remote restoration estimating experience.



What This Role Is NOT



* This is not an entry-level Xactimate position.

* This is not a position for someone who has only taken an Xactimate course but has limited real-world experience.

* This is not simple data entry.

* This is not sketch-only or price-list entry work.

* This is not a field estimator position.

* This is not a customer service or sales position.

* This position does not make insurance coverage determinations.



We need someone who understands why an estimate is written the way it is, not someone who simply knows how to enter Xactimate line items.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for an estimator who knows how to identify the legitimate scope necessary to properly complete a restoration project, document that scope, and prepare a detailed and defensible estimate.



We want someone who looks at the entire project and asks:



What work is actually necessary to complete this job properly, and is all of that work included and documented in the estimate?



We also want someone who understands the production side of restoration.



A repair estimate ultimately needs to provide our Project Manager with enough information and budget to execute the project properly while maintaining appropriate company profitability.



Accuracy, documentation, completeness, and attention to detail are extremely important to us.



Tools You May Use



* Xactimate

* XactAnalysis

* DASH by Next Gear Solutions

* DocuSketch

* Matterport

* Google Workspace

* Company CRM and file management systems



Schedule & Opportunity



This position will initially be part
-based because our estimating workload varies.



We are not currently guaranteeing 40 hours per week.



We are looking for the right person rather than simply filling a position.



For the right estimator, our goal is to develop a long-term working relationship, with the opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities as our workload grows.



Application Instructions



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application. Applications that do not answer these questions may not be reviewed.



1. How many years have you been using Xactimate professionally?

2. Describe your experience preparing water damage repair/reconstruction estimates.

3. Describe your experience preparing water mitigation estimates.

4. Have you prepared fire and smoke damage repair/reconstruction estimates? If yes, describe the types and approximate sizes of fire losses you have estimated.

5. Have you prepared mold remediation estimates? If yes, describe your experience.

6. Have you prepared contents or packout estimates? If yes, describe your experience.

7. Approximately what percentage of your estimating experience is:

    * Repair/reconstruction

    * Water mitigation

    * Fire

    * Mold

    * Contents/packouts

    * Other

8. Have you worked directly for a restoration contractor? If yes, describe your role and responsibilities.

9. Describe your experience preparing Xactimate supplements.

10. Give an example of a repair estimate where you identified legitimate missing scope from an insurance carrier’s estimate. What was missing, and how did you document it?

11. Have you ever taken an approved Xactimate estimate and separated it into subcontractor scopes and budgets by trade? If yes, explain your process.

12. How do you help ensure a reconstruction estimate is complete while also being financially workable for the contractor performing the repairs?

13. What information and documentation do you normally need before preparing a detailed repair estimate?

14. Have you used DocuSketch and/or Matterport? If yes, explain how you have used them for estimating.

15. Have you used DASH by Next Gear Solutions or another restoration CRM?

16. Which U.S. insurance carriers have you worked with, if any?

17. What is your current availability and approximately how many hours per week are you available?

18. What hourly rate are you seeking?

19. Please provide 1 to 3 examples of Xactimate estimates that you personally prepared. If possible, include examples that demonstrate different types of restoration work.



Remove all customer names, addresses, claim numbers, policy information, and other confidential information before submitting estimate samples.



Important Final Instruction



To confirm that you read the entire job posting, please begin your application with:



XACTIMATE ESTIMATOR



We are looking for real-world restoration estimating experience, not just Xactimate certifications.



Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a paid estimating test using a completed restoration project before we make a long-term decision.

title: Junior Gaming News Writer
description:
Arab Game News is looking for a Junior Gaming News Writer to join our growing editorial team.



Arab Game News is a gaming news website dedicated to covering the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), from the latest games and esports stories to the companies, events, creators and people shaping the region's rapidly growing gaming industry.



We're looking for someone who loves video games, follows gaming news and wants to build a career in digital media and journalism.



What you'll be doing

- Researching and writing gaming and esports news stories, with a particular focus on the Middle East and MENA region.

- Keeping up with gaming news, announcements, events, tournaments, publishers, developers and industry trends.

- Identifying interesting stories and pitching ideas relevant to Arab Game News readers.

- Turning press releases, announcements and other sources into clear, engaging and original news stories.

- Uploading, formatting and publishing articles through our Wix CMS.

- Sourcing appropriate images and media for stories.

- Sharing published stories across our social media channels.

- Writing engaging social copy and helping grow the Arab Game News audience.

- Occasionally contributing interviews, features and other longer-form content.

- Working with the editorial team to ensure stories are accurate, timely and well written.



What we're looking for



You don't need years of journalism experience. We're looking for someone at the beginning of their career who is enthusiastic, curious and keen to learn.



You should have:



- A genuine passion for video games and good knowledge of the gaming industry.

- A strong interest in the Middle East's gaming and esports scene.

- Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly and accurately.

- Good news judgement and an understanding of what makes an interesting story.

- Experience using a CMS. Experience with Wix is preferred.

- Experience using social media platforms to publish and promote content.

- An understanding of platforms such as X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube.

- The ability to research stories and verify information before publishing.

- Good attention to detail.

- The ability to work independently, manage deadlines and react quickly when news breaks.



Nice to have

- Previous writing experience, whether for a publication, university, personal blog or gaming website.

- Knowledge of the gaming and esports ecosystem in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider MENA region.

- Arabic language skills.

- Basic understanding of SEO and writing headlines for digital publications.

- Experience creating simple social media graphics, images or short-form video content.

- Existing relationships or familiarity with gaming publishers, developers, esports organisations or PR agencies in the region.



Who this role would suit



This is a great opportunity for a junior writer, journalism graduate, gaming enthusiast or aspiring games journalist who wants hands-on experience covering one of the world's fastest-growing gaming regions.



We're more interested in your passion for gaming, ability to spot a story and willingness to learn than a long CV.



If you're the person who is always sending your friends gaming news, following new releases, watching showcases and keeping an eye on what's happening in the MENA gaming scene, we'd like to hear from you.



How to apply



Please send us:



Your CV.

A short introduction telling us about yourself and the games you play.

Links to any previous writing or published work, if available.

Two gaming news stories you think Arab Game News should be covering right now, with a sentence explaining why for each.



Previous professional journalism experience is not required.

title: Email Marketing Specialist - Klaviyo expert wanted: own the email programme for two UK jewellery brands
description:
About us

We are Lily Charmed and Scream Pretty, two UK jewellery brands run by the same small, fast-moving team.



Lily Charmed is a charm jewellery brand built on sentiment and storytelling. Our customers are charm collectors and gift buyers.

Scream Pretty is a bold, curated ear jewellery brand. Mostly self-purchase, with a strong gifting element.



We sell direct to consumer on Shopify, wholesale to jewellers, department stores, gift boutiques and hotels, and on marketplaces including Amazon, Etsy, Wolf & Badger and Not On The High Street.



We are a lean team that uses AI and automation heavily. That means the person in this role gets real ownership from day one, direct access to the founder, and their ideas actually get tested instead of sitting in a queue.





Job description

We are looking for an
 marketing specialist to take full ownership of our
 programme across both brands, retail and trade. You will build the flows, write the copy, design the
s in Canva, and manage the segmentation that makes it all work.



This is not a "send what you are told" role. We want someone who looks at the data, spots the opportunity, and comes to us with the idea. If you enjoy testing subject lines, arguing for a better segment, and watching open and click rates climb because of something you built, you will like this job.





Your responsibilities

Plan the monthly
 calendar across four audiences: Lily Charmed retail, Lily Charmed trade, Scream Pretty retail and Scream Pretty trade. Send it to us in advance for sign-off. You will join marketing planning meetings with the founder and social media manager so campaigns are shaped together.

Build, write and design campaigns end to end. Copy, layout and graphics created in Canva from our brand kits. Share creative back with the team so it can be reused on social, on site and elsewhere in the business.

Build and maintain automated flows: welcome, browse abandonment, cart and checkout abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, VIP and trade-specific flows.

Set up keyword automations for Instagram to trigger
 list growth into the correct audience segments.

Own list health and segmentation. Build and refine segments by brand, purchase behaviour, engagement, and retail vs trade. Manage sunset flows, suppression and deliverability.

Own sign up forms and landing pages. Optimise existing forms, particularly the Lily Charmed imagery, and build new sign up landing pages for launches and collections.

Report monthly on open rate, click rate, revenue per recipient, list growth and flow performance. Tell us what you tested, what you learned, and what you recommend next.





Platforms you will work in

Klaviyo for retail on both brands. This is where most of your time goes.

Omnisend for trade newsletters.

Faire for trade newsletters on the marketplace.

Canva for all creative.

Shopify, 
 and Google Workspace day to day.





Required skills and experience

You will need at least 2 years of hands-on experience with:



Klaviyo, specifically flow building, segmentation, A/B testing and reporting. Shopify integration experience is essential.

Copywriting for
, including subject lines, preview text and body copy that sells without sounding pushy.

Canva or equivalent design skill, working to an existing brand kit and producing clean, on-brand
 graphics.

Perfect written British English. Spelling, grammar and punctuation must be UK standard. Jewellery not jewelry, colour not color, personalised not personalized. This is non-negotiable because our customers notice.

Ecommerce
 marketing for a consumer brand, ideally fashion, jewellery, accessories or giftware.





Soft skills

We are a small business and this role has a lot of independence. You will do well here if you are:



A genuine self-starter. You plan your own calendar and hit your deadlines without chasing.

Full of ideas. You bring suggestions to us rather than waiting for a brief. Show us inspirational
s you have found while researching competitors.

Detail-obsessed. No broken links, no wrong prices, no typos, no images that break on mobile.

Comfortable with data. You read the numbers and change what you do because of them.

A clear communicator. You ask questions early rather than guessing.





Nice to have

Not essential, but these will put you ahead:



Omnisend experience, or experience marketing to trade and wholesale customers.

SMS marketing in Klaviyo.

Basic HTML for
 troubleshooting.

Experience with review platforms, loyalty apps or Shopify apps that feed into Klaviyo.





Work schedule

This is a part-time role, roughly 16 hours a week across 2 days. Output is 2 to 3 campaign newsletters per brand per week, plus monitoring & building flows, forms and pop ups.



Hours are flexible, but we need at least 2 hours of overlap with UK working time (9am to 5pm London) on the days you work, so we can talk things through. A short weekly check-in call is expected.



We honour most Filipino holidays. You will qualify for paid leave after a 3 month probation period.





Rate

$10 per hour depending on experience. 16 hours per week - Hours can be split across the entire week TBC. That is approximately $694 per month





Perks and career potential

Rate review at 6 months based on
 revenue growth and performance.

You work directly with the founder and Director. No layers, no politics.

Real creative ownership across two brands with very different voices.

If
 performance grows the way we want it to, there is scope to increase hours and expand the role into wider retention and CRM work.





How to apply

Put "British English and Klaviyo, that's me" in the subject line.



Please send us:



Your CV.

Two examples of Klaviyo
s you designed and wrote yourself. Tell us the open rate and click rate for each, and what you would change if you built them again.

A short subject line test: write three subject lines for a Mother's Day campaign for a charm jewellery brand, and tell us in one sentence which one you would bet on and why.

A one-line answer to this: what is the first thing you would look at in a Klaviyo account you had just been given access to?



Applications without the subject line test will not be reviewed. We want to know you read this properly.



Any questions before you apply, just ask. We would rather answer them now.

title: Approvals & Applications Virtual Assistant

Patio & Shed Kits WA

Monday-Friday | 10:00am-1:00pm WST/AWST (Perth Time)

About the Position

Patio & Shed Kits WA is looking for a highly organised and technically capable Approvals & Applications Virtual

Assistant to work directly with our Operations Manager.

Your primary responsibility will be to help prepare patio and shed building applications in Western Australia,

ensuring that all required customer, property, engineering, surveying and application information is collected and

organised before the file is submitted to the Operations Manager for final review.

This is a long-term position for the right person.

Hours & Pay

• 15 hours per week

• 3 hours per day, Monday to Friday

• 10:00am-1:00pm Western Australian time (AWST/WST)

• AUD $15.00 per hour

• AUD $225 per week

• Remote position

You must be available during these hours so you can communicate directly with our Operations Manager,

customers, engineers and surveyors.

1. Customer Information

Contact customers and gather all information required to prepare their patio or shed application.

• Owner details and site address

• Property and project details

• Proposed patio or shed location

• Dimensions and boundary setbacks

• Existing structures

• Owner-supplied plans and site photographs

• Certificates and property documents

• Additional information requested by the engineer, surveyor or Operations Manager

• Follow up customers promptly when information is missing or incomplete.

2. BA1 & BA2 Applications

Assist with the preparation and completion of Western Australian BA1 and BA2 building approval forms and

associated documentation.

• Enter owner, applicant and property information

• Complete project descriptions

• Check required fields

• Identify missing information

• Organise supporting documentation

• Prepare applications for final review by the Operations Manager

3. Prepare Complete Application Packages

Turn information received from customers, engineers, surveyors and other sources into a complete and organised

application package.

• Packages may include BA1/BA2 documentation, site plans, owner-supplied plans, engineering, survey

information, property information, certificates, photographs, supporting documents and correspondence.

4. Plans & Drawings

Assist with basic plan preparation and checking, including reading building and site plans, scaling owner-supplied

title: Short-Form Gaming Content Creator / Video Editor – Plix.gg
description:
Plix.gg is a browser games portal with 72,000+ games and 180K+ monthly

visitors. We're hiring one person to own our short-form video output

end to end: find the games, record them, write the hooks, cut the

videos, post them.



This is NOT an editing-only role. We do not send you footage. If you

only want to edit clips someone else planned, this isn't your job.





WHAT YOU DO

- Dig through our catalogue and find games worth a video

- Record gameplay yourself (clean screen capture, 1080x1920)

- Write your own hooks and concepts — you are the ideas person

- Edit 10-40 second videos: captions, sound design, pacing, effects

- Post to our accounts and log how each one performed

- Test alternative opening hooks and tell us what worked



Concepts that work in this niche (starting points, not a template):

- "I found the weirdest game on the internet"

- "This browser game should NOT be this good"

- "3 games to play when you're bored at work"

- "Can you beat this level?"

- "3 games to play with your friends, no download"

Or even could be meme videos 



OUTPUT

15 finished videos per week.

Each one gets posted to TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

5 videos per week ship with a second opening hook for A/B testing.



We measure retention and views, not file count. Tell us when a concept

is weak instead of shipping it to hit a number.



HOURS

We don't care when you work. No fixed schedule, no timezone overlap,

no clocking in. Everything is scheduled in advance, so nobody needs

to be awake at upload time.



VOICE AND AI

You do not need to appear on camera or use your own voice.

- AI voiceover: allowed and encouraged

- AI captions and script assistance: fine

- AI-generated B-roll, stock slideshows, or the same template repeated

  across dozens of uploads: not allowed





SETUP YOU NEED

- A PC that runs browser games smoothly and records at 1080p

- A stable connection — you'll be uploading 15+ videos a week

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve — your choice, we don't care

- You'll deliver project files alongside exports





REQUIREMENTS

- Strong short-form editing, with work to show

- You genuinely understand hooks and first-3-second retention

- You play games and can tell when one is actually interesting

- Good written English and a feel for what makes a Western gaming

  audience stop scrolling

- You can work independently. We give feedback weekly, not hourly.





PAY

$900/month (approx 55,000 PHP), paid monthly via Wise.

Performance bonus on top, tied to monthly views across accounts.

13th month equivalent after 12 months.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with PLIX. Applications without it get deleted.



Send:

1. 3-5 short-form videos you edited. Say exactly what you did on each

   — did you shoot it, write it, or just cut it?

2. Your editing software

3. THREE video ideas for Plix.gg. Each one must name a specific game

   with its plix.gg URL, plus the exact opening line you would say.

   This is the part we actually judge you on. 

4. Your PC specs and a internet speed.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial video: 1,000 PHP, paid whether

or not we hire you. We run several trials at the same time.

title: HR Manager - Recruitment

title: SEO & Online Visibility Specialist – Google, Reddit, TikTok & AI Search
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for a smart, resourceful and highly motivated SEO and Online Visibility Specialist to help us dramatically increase our presence across the internet.



This is not a position where we simply need someone to write a few blog posts every month.



We want someone who is constantly looking for opportunities to get Natural Renewals and My Moss discovered across Google, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, AI search engines, directories, blogs, websites and other online platforms.



Your main goal will be simple:



Help more people discover our brand when they search for sea moss, sea moss gel, health foods and related products online.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for activities including:



* Perform SEO and keyword research for our website and products

* Identify keywords we should be ranking for on Google

* Improve existing website pages for SEO

* Research opportunities for backlinks and brand mentions

* Submit our company to relevant legitimate directories and websites

* Find blogs, websites, publications and communities where our company can be featured

* Research relevant Reddit conversations and opportunities for Natural Renewals to participate

* Help increase our visibility in Reddit and Google search results

* Research TikTok, YouTube and social media search trends related to sea moss and health foods

* Identify questions and topics consumers are actively searching for

* Help optimize our content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other platforms

* Research ways to improve how Natural Renewals and My Moss appear in ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and other AI-powered search tools

* Find websites and online resources where our brand should be mentioned

* Perform competitor research and identify where competing sea moss brands are getting traffic, links and exposure

* Conduct outreach to bloggers, websites, publications and potential partners

* Maintain spreadsheets documenting outreach, backlinks, brand mentions and SEO opportunities

* Monitor keyword rankings and website traffic

* Provide a short weekly report showing exactly what was completed, what changed and what opportunities were discovered



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



* Extremely resourceful

* A strong internet researcher

* Comfortable working independently

* Excellent at written English

* Familiar with SEO and digital marketing

* Comfortable using AI tools for research and productivity

* Familiar with Google Search Console and keyword research tools

* Familiar with Reddit, TikTok, YouTube and social platforms

* Able to find opportunities without constantly being told what to do

* Organized and able to document their work

* Interested in growing with a U.S.-based company long term



Experience with e-commerce, health and wellness brands, food brands or consumer products is a major plus.



IMPORTANT



We are not looking for spam.



We do not want:



* Thousands of low-quality backlinks

* Fake reviews

* Fake customer testimonials

* Automated spam comments

* Low-quality directory blasting

* Copied AI articles

* Mass-produced content with no strategy

* Fake Reddit conversations or fake customer accounts

* Anything designed only to manipulate rankings without creating real value



We want someone who understands how to create real online authority and visibility.



Quality matters more than quantity.



PAID TEST



Applicants who make the shortlist will be asked to complete a small paid test before we make our final hiring decision.



We want to see how you actually think and work.



PART 1 - WEBSITE AND SEO REVIEW



Review our website and identify at least 10 SEO opportunities.



For each opportunity, briefly explain:



* What you found

* Why it matters

* What you would change

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

title: WooCommerce Product Catalogue VA – Lighting / Electrical Products
description:
WooCommerce Product Catalogue VA – Lighting / Electrical Products



Strong Attention to Detail Essential



We are an Australian electrical and architectural lighting business looking for a **dedicated WooCommerce Product Catalogue VA** to join our remote team.



This is **not simply a data-entry position**.



We need someone who is extremely accurate, organised and willing to check information carefully before putting anything onto our website.



Our catalogue contains architectural lighting, LED strip, drivers, controls, aluminium profiles, downlights, garden lighting and other electrical products.



We already have an established VA team. You will work under **Jocy**, who will manage your tasks and priorities, and work with **Vega**, who assists with developing our systems and workflows.



The purpose of this new position is to give one person clear responsibility for maintaining the accuracy and quality of our WooCommerce lighting catalogue.



---



## ATTENTION TO DETAIL IS THE MOST IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



We need someone who notices things such as:



* A product incorrectly categorised as **0-10V** when it is actually DALI, TRIAC or not dimmable.

* A product title saying **14.4W/m** while the specification says **9.6W/m**.

* A product saying **2700K** in one location and **3000K** somewhere else.

* Missing SKUs.

* Missing prices.

* Missing stock quantities.

* Incorrect product variations.

* Incorrect photographs.

* Specifications that don't agree with the supplier's catalogue.



If something does not make sense, **do not guess**.



Stop, investigate the supplier information and ask the team.



Accuracy is more important than speed.



---



# Main Responsibilities



## WooCommerce Product Management



Create, update and maintain products inside WooCommerce including:



* Product names

* SKUs

* Categories

* Subcategories

* Product attributes

* Variations

* Pricing

* Wholesale pricing

* Stock quantities

* Stock status

* Product descriptions

* Technical specifications

* Product images

* Downloadable specification sheets

* Tags and filters



You will also regularly audit existing products and correct incomplete or incorrect information.



---



## Product Specifications



All technical information must be checked against the **original supplier information**.



This may include:



* Wattage

* Voltage

* Current

* CCT

* RGB / RGBW

* CRI

* Beam angle

* IP rating

* Dimensions

* Cut-out

* Driver type

* Dimming method

* DALI

* TRIAC

* 0-10V

* Tuya / Smart control

* PCB width

* LEDs/chips per metre

* Lumens

* Warranty

* Certifications



You are expected to identify conflicting information rather than simply copying it.



---



## Product Images



Our preference is always:



1. **Original supplier/manufacturer product image**

2. Supplier catalogue image

3. Supplier technical drawing/render

4. Professionally prepared product image

5. **AI-generated image only as a last resort**



Do not use AI-generated images when a genuine supplier photograph is readily available.



Images must also be correctly matched to the exact product.



---



## Stock Management



We are developing a trade catalogue where approved electrical contractors and wholesalers can log in and see our available products.



WooCommerce needs to become our reliable source of stock information.



You will help maintain:



* Correct stock quantities

* Stock management by SKU/variation

* Live stock availability

* Trade catalogue information

* Products requiring replenishment



Products that are not currently stocked will preferably be shown to customers as:



**SPECIAL ORDER**



rather than simply:



**OUT OF STOCK**



---



## Trade Customer Catalogue



We are also improving our contractor and wholesaler login system.



The successful applicant may assist with:



* Trade customer accounts

* Contractor/wholesaler registrations

* Checking catalogue access

* Wholesale pricing visibility

* Testing customer login accounts

* Identifying registration or approval problems

* Maintaining accurate trade catalogue information



We are developing a workflow where new trade applications can be reviewed quickly by members of our team.



---



# Skills We Are Looking For



### Essential



* Very strong attention to detail

* WooCommerce experience

* WordPress experience

* Experience creating and editing variable products

* Good spreadsheet/CSV skills

* Ability to compare data from multiple sources

* Good written English

* Ability to follow procedures

* Comfortable asking questions when information is unclear

* Reliable timekeeping

* Good organisation

* Ability to work independently



### Highly Desirable



Experience with:



* Electrical products

* Lighting products

* LED lighting

* Architectural lighting

* Electrical wholesale

* Product catalogues

* Inventory management

* Wholesale WooCommerce websites

* Canva

* Product photography/image preparation

* CSV imports/exports

* WooCommerce stock systems



You do **not** need to be an electrician.



However, somebody who is technically minded and enjoys understanding products will have a major advantage.



---



# What This Position Is NOT



We are not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes supplier information without checking it.



We are also not looking for someone who:



* Guesses missing information

* Publishes incomplete products

* Uses the wrong image because it looks similar

* Creates AI images unnecessarily

* Places products into categories without understanding them

* Marks work complete without checking it



There will sometimes be incomplete or contradictory supplier information.



We want somebody who **finds those problems**.



---



# How the Role Will Work



You will report primarily to **Jocy**, who will manage your tasks.



You will also work with **Vega**, who is helping us improve the workflows and systems used by our VA team.



A typical product workflow will become:



**Supplier Information**



? Check Product Information



? Confirm SKU



? Confirm Category



? Check Technical Specifications



? Find Correct Supplier Images



? Prepare/Check Specification Sheet



? Enter WooCommerce Product



? Enter Stock & Pricing



? Check Variations



? QA Review



? Publish



The aim is to build a catalogue that contractors and wholesalers can trust.



---



# We Value Accuracy Over Speed



We would prefer someone to correctly complete **10 products** rather than incorrectly complete **50 products**.



Once our processes are established, speed will naturally improve.



---



# How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



## **LIGHTING CHECKED**



This allows us to see who has read the advertisement carefully.



Then answer the following:



1. How many years of WooCommerce experience do you have?

2. Have you worked with variable WooCommerce products?

3. Have you imported or exported products using CSV files?

4. Have you maintained stock quantities in WooCommerce?

5. Have you worked with technical products before?

6. Have you worked with lighting or electrical products?

7. What would you do if the supplier catalogue said a product was **14.4W/m**, but the WooCommerce description said **9.6W/m**?

8. What would you do if you could not find an important specification?

9. When would you use an AI-generated product image?

10. What hours are you available each week?

11. What is your expected hourly rate?

12. Please provide examples of WooCommerce websites or product catalogues you have previously worked on.



### Small Attention-to-Detail Test



Please also tell us what is wrong with this information:



**Product:** 24V RGBW LED Strip

**Wattage:** 14.4W/m

**Colour:** RGBW 2700K

**Description:** RGBW 3000K, 19.2W/m

**Category:** 0-10V Drivers



Do not just say that there is an error.



Tell us **each item you would investigate before publishing this product.**



We are looking for a long-term team member who takes ownership of catalogue accuracy and is proud of producing reliable work.





Salary: USD $6.00/hour starting rate, with a performance and salary review after 3 months. We are looking for a long-term team member. Increased hours and salary will be available to someone who demonstrates exceptional accuracy, reliability and ownership of the WooCommerce catalogue.

title: Wholesale Sourcing VA - Amazon FBA UK/EU Supplier Research
description:
I run a UK-based Amazon FBA wholesale business and I'm looking for a full-time Sourcing VA. One job: find me suppliers nobody else has.



You are not doing outreach and you are not managing the pipeline - I handle all of that. Your entire focus is research: finding and qualifying UK and EU suppliers, then dropping them into my CRM (a Google Sheet I'll give you access to) with everything I need to contact them myself.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Authorised distributors, wholesalers and brand-direct relationships for brands that already sell on Amazon

- Niche, harder-to-find suppliers - the ones that take real digging

- Suppliers with genuine barriers to entry: high MOQs, trade-only access, application and approval processes, brand authorisation requirements

- Categories: health and beauty, household, grocery, baby, pet, toys, electricals, stationery, sports



WHAT I'M NOT LOOKING FOR

Anything findable in ten minutes on Google. No open-to-all dropship sites, no directories everyone already has, no "wholesale" sites that sell to the public. Low barrier to entry means every other seller is already there, which is no use to me.



WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO ALL DAY



Find them

- I'll give you my methods and source lists to start with, and I expect you to bring your own on top - if you have a way of finding suppliers that works, use it

- Typical angles: UK and EU trade show exhibitor lists, trade-only directories, brand websites' "stockists" and "where to buy" pages, Companies House, LinkedIn company and people search, EU trade portals

- Reverse-engineer brands already selling on Amazon UK to work out who distributes them here

- Check the CRM first - if it's already in there, move on



Qualify them

- Confirm they are a genuine wholesaler or authorised distributor, not a retailer or dropshipper

- Confirm they trade B2B, and check whether they allow Amazon sellers

- Find the MOQ, the minimum order value and whether there's an application process

- Judge the barrier to entry: is this one everybody already has, or is it hard to get into? Hard to get into is what I want



Get me the contact

- A named human where possible: name, job title, direct
, phone

- Buying, sales or national account managers preferred. Generic 
 as a last resort



Log them

- One clean row per supplier in the CRM: supplier name, website,
, phone, contact name and role, location, category, brands carried, MOQ, payment terms if listed, how you found them, and any notes on how hard they are to get an account with

- No duplicates, no half-filled rows



Report

- Short daily message: how many new suppliers you added and anything interesting you noticed

- Friday: a short summary of the week and where your best finds came from



TARGETS (we'll refine these together)

- 15+ genuinely new, suppliers per day

- Every row complete and logged the same day you find it

- Zero duplicates



YOU NEED

- Genuinely good at research - you enjoy digging, cross-referencing and finding the thing that isn't on page one

- Good written English for reading UK and EU trade sites and writing clear notes

- Comfortable in Google Sheets

- Organised and consistent - clean data is the whole job

- 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, with reasonable overlap with UK hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Previous Amazon FBA wholesale or online arbitrage sourcing experience

- Familiarity with Keepa, SellerAmp, Jungle Scout or similar

- Experience with EU/UK trade directories or trade show exhibitor lists

- Basic understanding of brand gating and IP restrictions on Amazon



WHAT YOU GET

- PHP 25,000/month to start, paid on time, every time

- Long-term full-time role - I want someone who grows with the business

- Training on my sourcing methods and my CRM

- Performance-based raises and bonuses for suppliers that turn into live accounts



HOW TO APPLY - read carefully, applications that skip this are deleted

Send your application with the subject line: Sourcing VA - [Your Name] - Distributor



In your message include:

1. A short paragraph on your research experience (no generic cover letters)

2. One example of a UK or EU wholesaler or distributor you found for an Amazon-selling brand, with the website, the brand(s) they carry, and one sentence on how you found them and why it isn't obvious

3. The research methods and tools you'd use to find trade-only suppliers

4. Your available hours in UK time



Tell me your favourite UK supermarket brand somewhere in the message so I know you read to the end.

title: Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
ATTN: introductory video, your résumé, and your portfolio is required to apply for this position.



About Us:

CURE Advanced Aesthetics Institute is a premier aesthetics and beauty school dedicated to preparing students for successful careers through advanced training, hands-on experience, and industry-recognized certifications. 



Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist



Position Summary



Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute is seeking a motivated, organized, results-driven Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist to help grow enrollment, strengthen prospective student relationships, manage incoming leads, and provide an exceptional customer experience.



This is a sales and conversion-focused position. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that prospective students who express interest in our programs receive timely, professional, consistent, and persuasive follow-up designed to move qualified prospects from inquiry to conversation, conversation to application, and application to enrollment.



The ideal candidate must be comfortable with sales, follow-up, telephone conversations, text messaging,
 communication, CRM systems, lead organization, customer service, marketing, and working toward measurable enrollment goals.



We are looking for someone who understands that every inquiry represents a potential student whose life and career may be positively impacted by the right educational opportunity. This individual must be able to build relationships, communicate value, overcome reasonable objections, follow up consistently, and help prospective students confidently determine whether our programs are the right fit for their goals.



?



Primary Responsibilities



Lead Management & Organization



The specialist will be responsible for maintaining an organized and effective lead-management system.



Responsibilities include:



* Receive and manage leads generated through websites, landing pages, Google Ads, social media, events, referrals, telephone calls,
, and other marketing sources.

* Ensure new leads are entered into the appropriate CRM or lead-management system.

* Respond to new inquiries promptly.

* Maintain accurate lead statuses and contact information.

* Categorize leads according to their stage within the enrollment process.

* Maintain detailed notes regarding conversations, interests, concerns, objections, follow-up dates, and next steps.

* Schedule appropriate follow-up activities.

* Prevent qualified leads from becoming lost due to inconsistent communication.

* Maintain an organized daily pipeline of prospects requiring attention.

* Identify older leads that should be re-engaged.

* Keep lead databases accurate, current, and organized.

* Identify high-intent prospects who may be ready to enroll.

* Track prospects from initial inquiry through enrollment.



Every qualified lead should have a clear status, a documented next step, and an appropriate follow-up date.



Sales & Enrollment Conversion



This individual must be comfortable selling educational programs and communicating the value of making an investment in professional education.



Responsibilities include:



* Speak confidently with prospective students regarding available programs.

* Explain program benefits, schedules, learning formats, tuition, payment options, enrollment requirements, and next steps accurately.

* Learn and understand the features, benefits, and ideal student profile for each program.

* Conduct professional sales and admissions conversations by telephone, text,
, video call, and other approved communication methods.

* Ask appropriate questions to understand the prospect’s goals, concerns, career interests, financial considerations, and barriers to enrollment.

* Help prospective students understand which program may best support their goals.

* Clearly communicate the value of the educational opportunity rather than focusing solely on price.

* Professionally address common objections involving tuition, scheduling, distance, fear, uncertainty, timing, and other enrollment concerns.

* Create urgency when appropriate without using misleading or high-pressure sales tactics.

* Ask qualified prospects for the enrollment.

* Provide clear instructions regarding the application and enrollment process.

* Follow up with prospects who begin but do not complete applications or enrollment.

* Re-engage prospective students who previously expressed interest but did not enroll.

* Work toward individual and organizational enrollment goals.



The specialist should understand that successful sales involves relationship building, listening, education, follow-through, confidence, and consistency.



Lead Follow-Up & Nurturing



Consistent follow-up is a major responsibility of this position.



The specialist will:



* Conduct daily follow-up with assigned prospective students.

* Utilize telephone calls, SMS/text messaging,
, and other approved channels.

* Follow established lead-nurturing sequences.

* Personalize communication when appropriate.

* Follow up after tours, consultations, information sessions, events, and applications.

* Reconnect with prospects who stop responding.

* Maintain appropriate communication without becoming unprofessional or excessively aggressive.

* Identify why prospects are not moving forward and communicate useful trends to leadership.

* Ensure scheduled follow-ups are completed on time.

* Create or recommend additional nurturing strategies when current approaches are not producing results.



CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



The specialist must be comfortable working with technology and maintaining accurate information within a CRM or lead-management platform.



Responsibilities may include:



* Maintain prospect records.

* Update lead stages.

* Enter notes after conversations.

* Schedule follow-up activities.

* Track appointments and consultations.

* Monitor application progress.

* Track enrollment outcomes.

* Identify overdue follow-ups.

* Help maintain automated
 and SMS campaigns.

* Identify duplicate or incomplete records.

* Produce or assist with lead and conversion reports.

* Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Leadpages, Google Sheets, Kajabi, or other systems adopted by the organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve automation and lead management.



Marketing Support



The specialist will work closely with leadership and other team members to help promote programs and generate qualified inquiries.



Responsibilities include:



* Assist with marketing campaigns for school programs.

* Help develop promotional messaging based on questions and concerns received from prospective students.

* Assist with
 and SMS campaigns.

* Support program launches, enrollment campaigns, open houses, information sessions, webinars, and special events.

* Help identify effective promotional opportunities.

* Review lead quality from different marketing sources and report findings to leadership.

* Communicate recurring questions and objections so marketing messages can be improved.

* Assist with basic social media and digital marketing activities when assigned.

* Work with the team to ensure advertisements, landing pages, sales messaging, and admissions conversations communicate a consistent message.

* Recommend new strategies for generating and converting qualified leads.



Customer Service & Student Experience



Excellent customer service is essential.



The specialist may be one of the first representatives a prospective student encounters and therefore must represent Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute professionally.



Responsibilities include:



* Provide warm, professional, knowledgeable service to prospective and current students.

* Answer general program and enrollment questions accurately.

* Respond to telephone calls,
s, text messages, and inquiries in a timely manner.

* Assist newly enrolled students with understanding their next steps.

* Help direct students to the appropriate staff member when an issue falls outside the specialist’s responsibilities.

* Handle concerns professionally and calmly.

* Document significant concerns or complaints.

* Escalate serious student or customer concerns to leadership appropriately.

* Follow through to ensure questions and concerns are addressed.

* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries with students and prospective students.

* Protect confidential student and business information.



Enrollment Onboarding & Handoff



The responsibility does not end immediately after a prospect says “yes.”



The specialist will help ensure a smooth transition from prospect to enrolled student.



Responsibilities include:



* Confirm required enrollment steps have been completed.

* Ensure necessary information is properly documented.

* Communicate orientation or onboarding information.

* Confirm students understand their immediate next steps.

* Coordinate with appropriate staff regarding newly enrolled students.

* Ensure the student receives a professional handoff from admissions into the educational experience.

* Identify incomplete enrollment requirements and follow up appropriately.



Sales Performance & Accountability



This is a performance-driven position.



The employee must be comfortable having performance evaluated using measurable indicators such as:



* Number of new leads received.

* Lead response time.

* Number of leads contacted.

* Number of meaningful conversations.

* Follow-up completion rate.

* Consultation or appointment bookings.

* Application starts.

* Application completion.

* Enrollment conversions.

* Lead-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* Re-engagement of older leads.

* Customer service responsiveness.

* CRM accuracy.

* Achievement of assigned enrollment goals.



The specialist will be expected to understand their numbers and work with leadership to improve performance when necessary.



Time Management & Productivity



Strong time-management skills are required.



The specialist must:



* Prioritize high-intent leads while maintaining appropriate follow-up with the entire pipeline.

* Complete assigned projects by the assigned due date and due time.

* Manage sales activities, marketing responsibilities, customer service, and administrative assignments simultaneously.

* Maintain an organized daily schedule.

* Respond promptly to time-sensitive inquiries.

* Complete scheduled follow-ups when promised.

* Communicate proactively when a legitimate issue may affect a deadline.

* Demonstrate reliability and consistency.

* Work independently without requiring constant reminders to complete routine responsibilities.



Communication Skills



The successful candidate must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills.



The specialist must be able to:



* Communicate confidently by telephone.

* Write professional text messages and
s.

* Explain complex information in simple terms.

* Listen carefully to prospective students.

* Ask effective discovery questions.

* Build rapport quickly.

* Communicate with empathy while remaining sales-focused.

* Professionally address objections.

* Ask for enrollment confidently.

* Maintain a professional tone during difficult conversations.

* Adjust communication styles appropriately for different prospective students.



Artificial Intelligence & Technology



Experience using modern technology and AI is strongly preferred.



The specialist should be able to:



* Utilize AI tools to improve productivity.

* Assist with developing follow-up messages,
 campaigns, sales scripts, FAQs, and marketing ideas.

* Use AI to organize information and improve workflows.

* Understand basic marketing automation.

* Quickly learn new CRM and technology platforms.

* Recommend ways technology and automation can improve lead response and conversion.

* Use technology to work more efficiently without sacrificing personalization or customer service.



Team Collaboration



The specialist will work closely with admissions, marketing, administration, instructors, and leadership.



The employee must:



* Communicate effectively with team members.

* Participate in meetings and sales training when required.

* Provide accurate updates regarding leads and enrollment activity.

* Share information that may help improve marketing and admissions strategies.

* Accept coaching and constructive feedback.

* Implement requested changes promptly.

* Support team enrollment goals in addition to individual goals.

* Maintain a professional and positive working relationship with staff.

* Communicate important prospective student concerns to the appropriate team member.



Required Skills



The ideal candidate should demonstrate:



* Strong sales ability.

* Strong customer service skills.

* Excellent telephone communication.

* Excellent written communication.

* Lead management experience.

* CRM experience.

* Sales pipeline management.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Strong follow-up skills.

* Ability to handle objections.

* Relationship-building skills.

* Marketing knowledge.

* Digital marketing familiarity.

* Basic understanding of landing pages and funnels.

* Strong computer skills.

* Google Ads and Google Workspace proficiency.

* Ability to learn new technology quickly.

* Strong time-management skills.

* Attention to detail.

* Problem-solving ability.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

* Professionalism and confidentiality.



Preferred Experience



Preference may be given to candidates with previous experience in:



* Admissions

* Education sales

* Career school admissions

* Enrollment advising

* Consultative sales

* Inside sales

* Lead generation

* Lead conversion

* CRM management

* Digital marketing

* Customer service

* Call-center sales

* Beauty, aesthetics, cosmetology, wellness, or healthcare education

* High-ticket products or services

* Financing or payment-plan conversations



Ideal Candidate Profile



Our ideal candidate is someone who can receive a new inquiry and immediately understand:



“This person should never become just another name on a spreadsheet.”



They will know how to make contact, build rapport, understand the prospect’s goals, communicate the value of our programs, address concerns, follow up consistently, organize the relationship within our CRM, and confidently guide qualified students toward making an enrollment decision.



We want someone who is:



Persistent without being pushy.

Confident without being aggressive.

Compassionate without losing focus on the sale.

Organized without needing constant supervision.

Creative enough to bring new ideas.

Competitive enough to want to reach goals.

Professional enough to represent our institution well.



Overall Performance Expectation



The Admissions Sales, Marketing & Lead Conversion Specialist is ultimately responsible for helping Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute create a reliable and professional pathway from:



Marketing ??Lead ??Contact ?? Relationship ?? Consultation ?? Application ??Enrollment ??Successful Student Handoff



We are looking for someone who understands that strong marketing generates opportunities, but excellent lead management, communication, customer service, follow-up, and sales conversion turn those opportunities into enrolled students.



The successful candidate will bring energy, discipline, organization, initiative, creativity, and a genuine desire to help prospective students move forward with their educational and career goals while contributing directly to the continued growth of Cure Advanced Aesthetics Institute.

This is not a traditional VA position. This is a performance-driven calling role.



We're looking for someone who:

- Is reliable, coachable and competitive

Calls are manually dialed through GoHighLevel — no auto dialer or power dialer.

MONDAY + THURSDAY

Approximately 16-20 hours/week

7:30–9:30 AM Central Time

4:00–8:00 PM Central Time



These hours are non-negotiable and produce the majority of our appointments.



If another job, school or commitment prevents you from consistently working these hours, please do not apply.



PERFORMANCE

We're looking for production, reliability and improvement, not someone who simply logs hours.

Training ? Role Play ? Live Calls ? Coaching ? More Calls

Strong performers can earn additional hours, performance bonuses and greater responsibility as the team grows.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



You'll fit well if you're:

- Competitive. Coachable. Reliable. Energetic. Resourceful.

- You don't need to feel 100% ready before taking action.



Your mentality is: FIGURE IT OUT ? ASK ? LEARN ? EXECUTE.



HOW TO APPLY: 

- Do NOT send a generic application or a dead résumé.

- Send a 60–90 second audio recording answering:



1. What outbound/cold-calling experience do you have?

2. What campaigns or industries have you called for?

3. Are you available every Monday & Thursday during BOTH required peak windows?

4. What's the most outbound calls you've made in one day?

5. Why would you perform well in this role?



Voice recording required. Applications without one will not move forward.



We're beginning paid auditions immediately.

title: Skilled TIKTOK video editor
description:
We’re looking for a video editor who genuinely cares about the quality of the final product—not someone who rushes through edits just to get them done.



We want someone who understands why content performs: what makes someone stop scrolling, keep watching, and ultimately take action. Every cut, hook, sound, transition, and detail should have a purpose.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Takes pride in their work and pays attention to the small details

Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

Knows how to edit content for performance, engagement, and conversions

Can adapt to different creative styles: nostalgic, Y2K, raw footage, organic, etc.

Willing to put in the extra effort to make an edit actually hit

Can think independently instead of relying on step-by-step instructions

Brings their own creative ideas and suggestions to the table

Takes feedback well and improves with every revision

Must be comfortable editing in CapCut



THE TYPE OF CONTENT

TikTok / Reels-style short-form content

Paid ads + organic content

Product-focused storytelling

Hook-driven, fast-paced, high-retention edits

Nostalgic, raw, real-life aesthetics

Content that feels native to social media—not overly polished or corporate



YOU’RE NOT A FIT IF YOU

Rush edits just to deliver them quickly

Throw clips together without thinking about the final result

Don’t understand hooks, pacing, or viewer retention

Need every detail explained before you can execute

Use the same editing style for every piece of content

Ignore small details

Only execute instructions without contributing creatively

Send us exactly 3 of your best TikTok-style edits. No more, no less.

Name the folder: Your Name / TOS Editor Position

LONG-TERM VISION

We’re not looking for someone to complete a few edits and disappear.

We want to find an editor we can build with long-term—someone who wants to grow alongside the brand and become an important part of the creative process.

As the brand grows, we want your role to grow with it. That means more responsibility, more creative input, and more opportunities.

We value people who constantly want to improve, experiment, and evolve their style. We want someone who can eventually understand our brand and content so well that they’re not just waiting for instructions—they’re bringing ideas to us.

If you want a role where your creative decisions actually matter and where you can grow with what we’re building, we’d love to see your work.

description:
Rite Care is a home healthcare and telehealth company serving patients in New Jersey and New York. We're growing, and we need someone to own one specific thing: making sure every new hire can actually log into everything on day one.



What you'll be doing



Creating and provisioning accounts for new staff across all of our platforms (EMR/EHR, scheduling, communication, time tracking, and more)

Coordinating with third-party IT vendors and software support teams to get accounts created, licenses assigned, and access issues resolved

Walking new hires through their first logins — MFA setup, password resets, browser and app installs — so they arrive at training ready to work, not stuck at a login screen

Screening job applicants for technical readiness: internet speed, computer specs, headset, backup power/connection, and quiet workspace

Handling ongoing access and login support for existing staff as issues come up

Keeping clean records of who has access to what, and removing access when someone leaves



What we're looking for



Prior experience with user account setup, IT helpdesk, or onboarding support

Comfortable being the person who follows up — a lot of this job is politely chasing a vendor until the account is actually created

Clear written and spoken English; you'll be walking non-technical people through technical steps

Patient and calm with people who aren't tech-savvy

Organized and detail-oriented — one missed account means a new hire sits idle on day one

Reliable high-speed internet, a working computer, headset, and a quiet place to work

Available during [YOUR HOURS, e.g. 9am–5pm EST]

Experience with healthcare software (EMR/EHR systems), or with tools like Connecteam, Airtable, or VoIP phone systems

Familiarity with HIPAA and handling access to systems containing patient information



Why this role



This starts as an onboarding and access role, but it will grow. For the right person, there's room to take on broader systems and operations responsibilities over time. We'd rather find someone we can invest in than fill a seat.

I will provide the raw talking clips, product clips/B-roll, script or general direction, and any specific brand requirements.



For these videos I need:



* Fast, clean cuts with dead space removed

* Strong pacing and retention

* Natural jump cuts

* Clean captions/on-screen text when needed
