title: Real Estate ISA Operations, CRM & Social Media VA
description:
accuracy before speed



We are a St. George, Utah real-estate business hiring a long-term Real Estate ISA Operations, CRM and Social Media Virtual Assistant. You will support our Desert Color Neighborhood Desk and help licensed agents and prospecting specialists operate from clean data, complete records and reliable follow-up systems.



This role follows National Association of Expert Advisors (NAEA) ISA operating principles adapted for a remote, unlicensed support position. It is not a cold-calling or appointment-setting position.



CORE OUTCOMES

- Every lead and property record is complete, factual, source-dated and easy for the licensed team to act on.

- Every interaction assigned to you is documented accurately in GoHighLevel.

- Follow-up tasks, handoffs and exceptions are visible; nothing disappears in the CRM.

- Call recordings and transcripts become useful QA scorecards, coaching notes and process improvements.

- Approved content is adapted into platform-specific social-media drafts and queued for Dan's approval.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research properties through approved public records, PropertyRadar and official community sources.

- Match parcel numbers, unit numbers, property addresses and current-owner records carefully.

- Identify duplicate contacts, stale ownership, missing fields, conflicting sources and records requiring human review.

- Maintain a source-dated Desert Color knowledge base covering communities, builders, property types, amenities, associations and verification sources.

- Maintain GoHighLevel records, notes, tags, pipeline status, follow-up tasks and handoff details according to a defined process.

- Audit prospective, active and closed lead status and prepare conversion and exception reports.

- Review call recordings and transcripts for call goal, script delivery, neighborhood knowledge, actionable questions, empathy, active listening, interruptions, professionalism, energy and next coaching actions.

- Help improve checklists, CRM processes and reporting when recurring problems are found.

- Learn and document our printing, file, delivery and other approved operating procedures.

- Prepare
, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and other platform-specific captions, hashtags, links and draft schedules from approved source material.

- Load social-media drafts into approved scheduling tools for Dan's review.



ROLE BOUNDARIES

You will not cold-call, prospect, solicit, negotiate, give pricing opinions, explain contracts, provide licensed real-estate advice or set appointments through prospecting. You may not independently send follow-up messages, publish social posts, schedule posts to go live, boost content, reply as Dan or send direct messages. Dan must approve every outbound batch before publication or sending.



THE NAEA-ALIGNED PERSON WE WANT

- Growth mindset: actively asks for feedback, accepts it and acts on it.

- Add value: looks for useful improvements for clients and teammates.

- 100/0 ownership: accepts responsibility and asks what could have been done differently.

- Open and real: communicates problems, disagreements and uncertainty respectfully.

- Leaders create leaders: documents processes and helps teammates succeed without needing credit.

- Make it happen: meets deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

- Strong professional English, attention to detail and solution-oriented problem solving.

- Positive, enthusiastic, dependable and respectful.

- Highest level of integrity with confidential information.

- Naturally curious and comfortable writing "not verified" rather than guessing.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists and defined processes without working mechanically.

- Able to manage focused work blocks, CRM documentation, follow-up tasks and daily reporting.

- Able to overlap at least three working hours with Mountain Time.



TOOLS YOU MAY LEARN

GoHighLevel, PropertyRadar, public county records, spreadsheets, knowledge-base tools, social scheduling tools and AI-assisted transcription and call-quality review. Experience with every tool is not required. Coachability, judgment, communication and accurate execution matter more.



TO APPLY

Put "accuracy before speed" in the first line and submit:

1. A 60-90 second audio introduction explaining your WHY and why this role fits you.

2. A brief example of feedback or criticism you received, what you changed and the result.

3. An example of a failure or missed deadline and what you could have done differently.

4. An example of when you added value or went the extra mile for a client or teammate.

5. A difficult record, CRM issue or research conflict you reconciled.

6. A sanitized spreadsheet, database or CRM sample with all confidential information removed.

7. One fictional or sanitized topic adapted into different
 and Instagram captions.

8. Your answer: What do you do when two reliable sources disagree?

title: Estimator
description:
REMOTE CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR

Philippines-Based | Full-Time | U.S. Commercial Construction



Oceanview Building Group is a South Florida general contractor specializing in premium healthcare interiors, including dental offices, medical clinics, and cosmetic surgery facilities.



We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator, who can independently prepare accurate takeoffs, detailed estimates, subcontractor scopes, and bid comparisons for U.S. commercial construction projects.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands construction drawings, knows how projects are built, and can identify missing scope before it becomes a costly change order.



Key Responsibilities



* Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection drawings.

* Complete accurate quantity takeoffs and detailed cost estimates.

* Develop scopes of work organized by CSI division and trade.

* Prepare subcontractor bid packages and invitations to bid.

* Review, compare, and level subcontractor proposals.

* Identify exclusions, missing scope, drawing conflicts, and constructability concerns.

* Request pricing from subcontractors and suppliers.

* Prepare conceptual budgets when drawings are incomplete.

* Maintain estimating templates, historical pricing, and subcontractor databases.

* Assist with value engineering and cost-saving recommendations.

* Prepare clear estimate summaries for management review.

* Support project handoff from estimating to operations.

* At least 4 years of construction estimating experience.

* Experience estimating U.S. commercial interior construction projects.

* Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

title: Instagram Publishing Assistant (Remote, Contract)
description:
Instagram Publishing Assistant (Remote, Contract)

Company: lowk — anonymous school polls app for US high schoolers Location: Fully remote. Type: Contract, 10 hrs/week to start. Scales with the number of accounts.



The job in one line

You build 10 high school Instagram accounts by finding schools with around a
high school student population and getting the follower count to at least 100.



What you'll do

You'll take 10 lowk school Instagram accounts from zero to a follower base that mirrors the actual student body of each assigned high school, targeting 20% of enrollment followed per account before that account goes public. The core loop is sourcing and following students who have that school named in their bio, and your job is knowing where those students cluster: start with the school's hub accounts — ASB/student government, class-of accounts 
 2028), varsity and JV sports teams, cheer, dance, band, drama, and club accounts — and work systematically through their followers, tagged posts, and follow-backs. From there, mine comment sections: the students commenting on a classmate's post are almost always at the same school, and threading through 5–10 comment sections surfaces entire friend groups faster than follower lists do. Every follow must clear two checks before you hit the button — (1) the bio explicitly names the target high school, and (2) the account belongs to a current high school student, meaning any bio with a college name, a committed-to school, a passed graduation year, or a "c/o" year earlier than this one is skipped, not followed. Equally important is account survival: you are responsible for keeping all 10 accounts unrestricted, which means working inside strict daily follow ceilings, warming new accounts before scaling, spacing actions instead of bursting, and stopping cold on any account that throws an action block rather than pushing through it. You'll log daily follows, follow-back rate, and any restriction events per account in the master sheet, and flag schools where the sourcing pool runs dry before the 20% target.



You will name each account “(school)polls”, either an abbreviated version like “shspolls” or the whole thing like “santiagopolls” depending on availability. You will attach a given bio copy and paste it as the bio of each account, make sure it’s private (super important), and place the school logo on the profile picture.

Core objective: You will keep track of the numbers on a simple spreadsheet. Look for 10 southern California high schools, each with a student population of about
. Get the follower request count to at least 100 on all accounts.

Rules of thumb (non-negotiable):

Warm-up: new account = 80 is the absolute max number of follows you should do on day 1, spread across two different times (40 in the morning, 40 at night for instance), 100 the next day with the same split. Follow at least 5 school based accounts (the school itself, the school’s student council/news, any basketball/volleyball/football teams, etc). Never mass-follow on a fresh account, this will lead to restrictions in following. If this happens, it’ll take even longer to reach the goal.

Blocked = stop: action block means 24–48 hours of zero activity on that account. Do not follow or do anything on that account and move onto the next if restrictions happen. Ensure to tell Cayden, and get back to the account after 2-48 hours have past. Retrying through a block escalates it to a longer or permanent restriction.

No third-party automation tools ever.

No churn: never unfollow to inflate ratio. Follow/unfollow cycling is the single fastest path to a permanent block.



What we're looking for

Required

Experience running multiple social accounts on a fixed daily schedule.

Meticulous. This role is judged almost entirely on whether the right post went out, on the right account, on the right day, with the right school name on it.

Google Sheets.

Reliable internet and a consistent daily working window.

English good enough to read instructions precisely and flag problems clearly. You are not writing content.



Begin your application with "LOWK ROLE" so we know you read this section



Compensation

$40 fixed for the entire project.



How to apply

1, Links to social accounts you've managed, if you can share them.

2, Your timezone and realistic daily working window in US Pacific terms.

3, When can you get started

4, Any questions you may have



We reply to everyone within a day or two.

title: Credit Repair Dispute Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our growing team.

This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands the credit dispute process and can step into an established workflow without requiring extensive training on the fundamentals.



POSITION DETAILS

* Starting Rate: $5/hour

* Trial Period: 2-week PAID trial

* Trial Schedule: Part-time hours

* Long-Term Opportunity: Successful candidates may transition into a consistent/full-time role after the trial period

* Work Environment: Remote

* Long-Term Growth: We are building a dispute team, so there is opportunity for increased responsibility as the company grows.

* 

YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:

* DisputeFox

* CFPB disputes

* Experian backdoor methods/processes

* Credit report analysis

* Client documentation review

* Identity theft and factual dispute workflows

* Bureau dispute submissions

* Handling multiple client files simultaneously

* GoHighLevel or similar CRM systems

You should understand how to review a client's credit profile, identify inaccuracies/inconsistencies, determine the appropriate dispute strategy, properly document your work, and move files through the dispute process efficiently.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:

* Is highly organized and detail-oriented

* Follows SOPs and instructions exactly

* Understands dispute strategy—not just how to generate letters

* Can manage multiple client files without becoming disorganized

* Works efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

* Communicates professionally with team members

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Takes accountability for their work

* Can receive feedback and make corrections quickly

* Does not require heavy training on basic credit dispute processes

* 

PRODUCTIVITY EXPECTATIONS

This is an hourly production-based role.

During the trial period, we will evaluate your:

* Accuracy

* Efficiency

* Quality of dispute work

* Ability to follow our SOPs

* Organization and documentation

* Communication

* Reliability

* Overall client-file output

* 

As you become familiar with our internal processes, an initial benchmark will be approximately 5–8 completed client dispute files during a full working day, depending on file complexity.

Quality and accuracy come first. We are not looking for someone who rushes through client files simply to hit a number.



2-WEEK PAID TRIAL

All candidates selected for this position will begin with a 2-week paid trial period with part-time hours.

The purpose of the trial is to make sure we are a good long-term fit and to evaluate your actual work—not just your interview.

Candidates who demonstrate strong accuracy, productivity, reliability, communication, and the ability to follow our processes may be offered a consistent/full-time position.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit ALL of the following:

1. Your resume

2. A 2–3 minute Loom/video introducing yourself and briefly explaining:

    * Your previous credit dispute experience

    * How long you've worked with DisputeFox

    * Approximately how many client files you have managed at one time

    * Your general dispute workflow/process

3. Blurred/redacted screenshots demonstrating your experience inside relevant systems/platforms.?Do not include any client names, Social Security numbers, addresses, account numbers, or other sensitive client information.

4. Answer the following question:

“You receive a new client file containing collections, charge-offs, late payments, and inconsistent personal information across the three credit bureaus. Walk us through how you would review the file, determine what should be addressed first, and begin the dispute process.”



IMPORTANT

To confirm that you actually read this entire job post, put:

“CFPB READY”

at the very top of your application.



Applications that are missing the phrase, resume, video, screenshots, or written response will not be considered.

title: Short Form Video Editor for Music Artist
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for a highly creative Short Form Video Editor to work long term with an independent Christian hip hop artist.



This role is focused specifically on editing social media content.



You will not be responsible for managing social media accounts, answering comments, running ads, or handling marketing operations.



Your job is to take raw footage and turn it into fast paced, current, highly engaging short form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.



THE STYLE WE NEED



We are looking for someone who understands:



• Gen Z content



• Fast paced short form editing



• Retention focused editing



• Strong first second hooks



• Platform native TikTok and Instagram editing



• Music culture



• Hip hop culture



• Memes and internet culture



• Pattern interruptions



• Creative subtitles and text



• Sound effects



• Music synchronization



• Visual storytelling



• Organic looking edits



• High energy edits



• When to heavily edit a video and when to keep it simple



You should understand what content looks like right now, not what social media videos looked like three years ago.



We need edits that are built to compete for attention on modern social platforms.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



Our content library includes:



• Music videos



• Performance footage



• Studio footage



• Vlogs



• Behind the scenes content



• Interviews



• Lifestyle footage



• Gaming content



• Talking videos



• Long form videos



• Promotional music content



• Release content



You should be able to take longer footage and independently identify moments that can become strong short form videos.



We do not want to provide timestamps for every edit.



Part of your value should be recognizing what the content is.



CREATIVE REFERENCES



You should study content from artists such as:



• Miles Minnick



• Hulvey



• Lecrae



• Caleb Gordon



• Alex Jean



These are references for understanding the Christian hip hop market, culture, artist presentation, and content ecosystem.



However, we DO NOT want the content limited to Christian hip hop references.



You should also regularly study mainstream hip hop artists, creators, streamers, entertainment accounts, meme culture, TikTok trends, and other high performing social media content.



We want to take what is working across internet culture and creatively adapt it to a Christian hip hop artist without simply copying other people.



THIS IS NOT CORPORATE VIDEO EDITING



Please do not apply with a portfolio primarily consisting of:



• Real estate videos



• Restaurant content



• E commerce advertisements



• Corporate videos



• Basic podcast clips



• Talking head videos with automatic captions



• Generic business Reels



• Template based edits



Those examples do not help us evaluate whether you are right for this position.



We are specifically looking for music, artist, creator, entertainment, Gen Z, culture driven, or highly creative short form editing.



EXPERIENCE



Direct music industry experience is preferred but NOT required.



We care more about your creative ability than your resume.



If you are extremely talented at editing but have not had the opportunity to work with artists professionally yet, you are still encouraged to apply.



If your portfolio does not currently demonstrate this exact style but you believe you have the technical and creative ability to execute it, we may invite you to complete a paid test edit using our footage.



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST



We want someone who:



• Has excellent creative instincts



• Understands current social media culture



• Watches Reels and TikTok enough to know what is actually trending



• Is strong in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, or similar software



• Can edit quickly without sacrificing quality



• Understands hooks and retention



• Can recognize good moments inside raw footage



• Can bring their own ideas to an edit



• Does not need every transition, sound effect, caption, or cut explained to them



• Takes feedback well



• Communicates consistently



• Meets deadlines



• Wants a long term position rather than a temporary editing project



This position will initially be approximately 10 to 15 hours per week, with the opportunity for more work as the relationship and artist continue to grow.



IMPORTANT QUALITY STANDARD



We are not hiring simply because we need more editing capacity.



We are hiring because we want to improve the quality of the content.



Our artist already has professionally edited social media and music content.



The person we hire needs to be capable of eventually producing content that is at least at our current level and ideally better.



If modern music artist content, Gen Z editing, TikTok culture, and creative short form videos are not your strengths, this will probably not be the right position for you.



HOW TO APPLY



Please create ONE Google Drive folder and send us the link.



Your folder should contain:



1. Your Best 3 to 5 Relevant Videos



Only include examples that represent the type of editing we are hiring for.



We would rather see three incredible edits than twenty average ones.



Please prioritize:



• Music content



• Artist content



• Creator content



• Gen Z content



• Entertainment content



• Fast paced short form videos



• Creative social media edits



Please DO NOT fill the folder with unrelated business or corporate work.



2. Short Introduction



Include a short document answering:



Why does this specific position interest you?



What type of content do you personally enjoy editing?



Which creators or artists do you currently think have some of the best short form content?



What editing software do you use?



How many hours per week are you currently available?



3. Portfolio



You may also include your full portfolio if you have one, but make sure the 3 to 5 relevant videos are easy for us to find first.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted applicants will receive additional information about the artist and current social media content.



At that stage, we will evaluate whether your creative style fits what we are building.



Some applicants may also be invited to complete a paid test edit.



We are looking for someone creative, hungry, current, dependable, and interested in building with us long term.

title: Instagram Content Creator — Design + Local Research (Canva + AI)

Instagram Content Creator — Design + Local Research (Canva + AI)



We're a fast-growing Instagram media brand covering a major U.S. city —

local news, business, real estate & development, food, and culture. We turn

what's happening in the city into scroll-stopping posts that locals actually

share. We're small, we move fast, and we're looking for one sharp content

creator to own daily production with us.



This is NOT a "design what we hand you" job. You'll help find the stories,

shape the ideas, and build the posts.



SEE OUR PAGE FIRST

Study our brand before you apply: 

Get a feel for our style, tone, and the kind of stories we tell.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design 3–4 Instagram posts per day — carousels and single images — in

  Canva, on-brand and consistent.

  done, what's coming, and what you need.



WHO YOU ARE

- Strong Canva skills with a real portfolio of Instagram content

  (carousels especially).

- A researcher at heart — curious, resourceful, and able to learn a city

  and an audience quickly.

- Comfortable using AI tools to work faster, and eager to get better at it.

- Sharp eye for layout, typography, and visual storytelling.

- Excellent written English and reliable, self-directed, consistent.

- Available on a regular weekly schedule (this is close to full-time volume).



BONUS POINTS

- You've designed for a city news, local media, lifestyle, or community brand.

- You have a journalism, media, or communications background.

- You can also do light short-form video editing (Reels).



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is how we filter)

1. Start your message with the word "SKYLINE" so we know you read the

   whole post.

2. Send 2–3 samples of Instagram content you've designed — carousels

   preferred. A live portfolio link is fine.

3. Mini-task (this matters more than your résumé): Look at our page, then

   pick any U.S. city you DON'T live in. In 3–4 sentences, pitch one local

   Instagram post idea you'd make for that city — the topic, the hook

   (first line), and why locals would share it.

4. Tell us which AI tools you use and one example of how you've used them

   in your work.



Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed. We'll invite the

strongest few to a short paid test project.

title: Studio Growth & Enrollment Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**



We are a growing dance studio with a strong reputation in our community. We believe dance is about far more than movement. We build confidence, leadership, friendships, and lifelong skills through the art of dance. We are looking for someone who genuinely wants to help share that mission and welcome new families into what we are building.





**What This Role Is**



This is a remote, part time position and it is heavily sales focused. The core of this role is outbound outreach to warm leads who have already expressed interest in the studio. These are real people who opted in. Your job is to connect with them, build genuine rapport, and move them toward enrollment through real conversations.



This role is built for someone who can own it. We will give you the structure, the tools, and the direction. After that, we expect you to run with it. The goal is for the right person to own this role fully with little to no hand holding from management. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



This role will evolve. The core is outreach and enrollment, but the scope will grow and shift based on what the studio needs. Some days that means following up with leads. Other days it might mean hunting for new ones, supporting a campaign, creating content, or finding creative ways to generate interest in the community. Whatever drives growth is fair game, and the right candidate will embrace that rather than push back on it.





**What You Will Do**



- Call new leads as fast as possible the moment they come in. The first studio to make contact almost always wins.

- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured outreach system

- Manage leads through a full follow up cadence and know where every lead stands at all times

- Log all activity and report daily on outreach and lead responses

- Hunt for new leads through social media, community groups, and online platforms

- Support seasonal campaigns, content creation, and community outreach as needed

- Take on additional tasks as the role grows and studio needs shift





**What We Are Looking For**



- English level C1 or higher, spoken and written. We will assess this.

- Exceptionally strong phone presence. This is the number one filter for this role. You need to sound calm, confident, and in control on every call. Prospects can feel hesitation and uncertainty immediately, and it kills trust before the conversation even starts. If you are smooth, natural, and able to guide a conversation without fumbling, you will thrive here. If phone calls make you nervous or unsure, this is not the right fit.

- Experienced in sales, lead follow up, or relationship based outreach

- Highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently without daily oversight

- Motivated by results and energized by conversations

- Experience with CRM tools or lead tracking systems is a plus

- A background or genuine interest in dance is a bonus, not a requirement





**Schedule**



- Part time, 20 hours per week spread across 7 days

- Availability required during Pacific Standard Time business hours

- Payment is made bi weekly via Wise





**Why This Role Matters**



Every family that reaches out is looking for something real for their child or for themselves. Your job is to make sure they find it here. The faster you respond, the more genuine your follow up, and the better you understand what they need, the more lives this studio gets to impact. This is not a job where you clock in and clock out. It is a role where the right person makes a real difference.



**To Apply**



Send your resume and a short introduction explaining why you would be a great fit. Tell us about a time you followed up consistently with someone and it made a real difference.



Put **Blue Elephant** in the subject line or message title. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Video Editor & Social Media Content Producer
description:
I’m building Lost Coast Naturals, a minimalist skincare brand focused on simple, functional products, and I’m looking for someone to work with me on short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I’ve been documenting the process of building the brand, so I have a growing library of product footage and photography, along with ideas for videos. What I need help with is consistently turning those ideas into complete pieces of content.



A big part of the role is video editing, but I’m hoping to find someone who can also help shape an idea before we get to the edit. Sometimes I’ll have a clear concept and the footage ready to go. Other times I may need help figuring out the hook, a simple script, how the video should flow, or what additional shots would make it work.



What I’d like help with:



* Editing short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

* Turning rough ideas into clear video concepts

* Helping with hooks, scripts, and video structure

* Giving some direction on how or where to shoot something when needed

* Adding music, text, sound, transitions, and other editing elements where they make sense

* Developing new content ideas and repeatable formats over time



The brand and style:



Lost Coast Naturals is a founder-led brand, so part of the content will tell the story behind the business and bring me into it. But the products and formulas are the hero.



Visually, the brand is minimalist, functional, and somewhat technical, with a clean and restrained aesthetic that intentionally feels different from a typical skincare or lifestyle brand.



More than anything, I’m looking for someone with good taste and creativity. I like collaborating with people who are confident in their skills, have their own point of view, and are comfortable suggesting a different direction when they think it will make the work better.



I want someone who understands what makes social content engaging, but also knows when keeping something simple is the better creative choice.



You can check out 
 to get a feel for the products, photography, and overall brand identity. If you understand the concept and feel like it’s something you can connect with, we’ll probably work well together.



The role:



I’m thinking around 10 to 15 hours per week to start, with the possibility of growing from there.



I’d like to eventually get into a rhythm of creating around 3 to 4 strong pieces of short-form content per week, but I care more about making good content than posting something just to hit a number.



The goal is for this to be collaborative. I’ll continue bringing ideas, setting the creative direction, and shooting content, but I’d also love someone who brings ideas of their own. I’m looking for someone who can help brainstorm new concepts, shape rough ideas into something we can actually make, and then help bring them across the finish line.



If we work well together, I’d love for this to become a long-term role.



To apply:



Please send:



1. A little about yourself and the type of work you normally do.

2. 3 to 5 examples of short-form videos you’ve worked on.

3. Which piece in your portfolio you think best fits the style of Lost Coast Naturals.

4. A little about how involved you typically are beyond editing, such as helping with hooks, scripts, video structure, or planning what footage is needed.

5. Your normal weekly availability.

Our company provides transportation, warehousing, cross-docking, refrigerated logistics, sourcing and integrated supply-chain services across Canada. The new identity must feel capable of competing for major enterprise and government contracts: modern, confident, memorable and operationally credible. The work must be original and should not resemble a generic courier or low-cost delivery brand.



Required deliverables:

• Discovery session and brand strategy

• Market positioning, value proposition and audience definition

• Brand story, messaging pillars, tagline options and tone of voice

• Primary logo, secondary logo, icon/mark and monochrome versions

• Colour palette and typography system

• Complete brand guidelines

• Business card, letterhead and
-signature designs

• Capability-statement/proposal cover and presentation template

• Website visual direction or UI style kit

• Social-media profile and cover assets

• Vehicle, warehouse/signage and uniform mockups

• Brand launch and transition recommendations

• Editable source files plus print-ready and web-ready exports



We expect:

• Multiple initial creative directions

• A clearly defined revision process

• Full ownership of approved original work upon final payment

• Commercially licensed fonts and assets, with all third-party licensing disclosed

Ideal candidate:

• Strong portfolio of complete B2B, logistics, industrial or supply-chain rebrands

title: META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – PURE DROPSHIPPING
description:
# META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – PURE DROPSHIPPING



**Starting Salary: $600 USD/month**

**Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance**

**Full-Time | Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM**



---



# ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



We are constantly testing new products through **Meta Ads —
 and Instagram advertising.**



Every week, our Product Team creates approximately **40 new product pages**.



Once those product pages are approved, they are shared with our
 Ads team.



This is where **you come in.**



You will be assigned approximately **40 product links every week**.



Your responsibility will be to take those product pages and turn them into **fully prepared Meta advertising campaigns.**



You will download the product images, understand the product, research the appropriate audience and interests, create the campaigns according to our systems, and make sure everything is accurate and ready to launch.



This is an important part of our advertising operation.



The quality and accuracy of your campaign setup directly affects the work of our Meta Ads team.



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Your core responsibility is:



## **40 PRODUCTS ? 40 META CAMPAIGNS EVERY WEEK**



For every assigned product, you will:



1. Open the Shopify product page.

2. Study and understand the product.

3. Download the necessary product images.

4. Understand who the product is designed for.

5. Research appropriate
/Meta interests.

6. Select relevant targeting based on the product and our SOPs.

7. Create the Meta campaign.

8. Upload and organize the correct product creatives.

9. Configure the campaign correctly.

10. Check every setting before submission.

11. Make sure the campaign is completely accurate and ready for launch.



You will repeat this process across approximately **40 products every week.**



---



# THIS IS NOT A ROBOTIC JOB



Although the workflow is repetitive, **we do not want someone who works like a robot.**



This is extremely important.



You will be creating campaigns for men's products, but our products can be very different from one another.



You may work with:



* Men's clothing

* Jackets

* Shirts

* Pants

* Shoes

* Accessories

* Fashion products

* Other men's products



You need to be able to look at a product and think:



**Who would be interested in this?**



**What type of person would buy this?**



**What interests would make sense?**



**What audience should we test?**



**Is there a better interest I could find?**



We already have SOPs and systems, but we also want someone who can **think.**



If you find a better interest, a better targeting idea or a better way to structure the campaign, we want you to bring that idea to the team.



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND
 / META ADS — CURRENTLY



We are looking for someone with **real, current Meta Ads experience.**



Not someone who ran
 Ads several years ago and assumes everything is still the same.



Meta changes constantly.



The platform, targeting options, campaign structures and best practices evolve.



You need to be actively familiar with **how Meta Ads works today.**



You should already understand:



* Meta Ads Manager

* Meta Business Manager

* Campaigns

* Ad Sets

* Ads

* ABO

* CBO

* Meta Pixel

* Targeting

* Interests

* Audiences

* Budgets

* Placements

*
 Pages

* Instagram accounts

* Ad creatives

* Campaign setup



You should be comfortable working inside Meta Ads Manager without needing someone to teach you the fundamentals.



---



# INTEREST RESEARCH IS IMPORTANT



One of your responsibilities will be finding appropriate **Meta interests and targeting options** for the products you are assigned.



We don't want someone who simply chooses the first interest that comes to mind.



We want someone who is willing to research.



For example, if you receive a men's fashion product, you should be able to think beyond one obvious interest.



You should be curious about:



* Fashion interests

* Clothing interests

* Lifestyle interests

* Brands

* Related products

* Hobbies

* Demographics

* Customer behavior

* Different audience angles



You need to develop an understanding of the **men's apparel and men's product market** over time.



The more products you work with, the better you should become at understanding:



**Product ? Customer ? Interest ? Audience**



---



# EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have:



* **At least 2–3 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.**

* Strong experience with Meta Ads Manager.

* Experience with Meta Business Manager.

* Experience creating and launching Meta campaigns.

* Strong understanding of
/Instagram advertising.

* Strong understanding of Meta interests and targeting.

* Experience with ABO and CBO.

* Experience with Meta Pixel and tracking.

* Experience with e-commerce or dropshipping advertising.

* Strong attention to detail.

* **Excellent written and spoken English.**

* Strong organizational skills.

* Ability to work independently.

* Ability to follow SOPs.

* Ability to learn quickly.

* Ability to adapt to Meta's constant changes.



**If you do not have at least 2–3 years of real hands-on Meta Ads experience, please do not apply.**



---



# WE WANT PEOPLE WITH SPARK



Technical knowledge is important.



But it is not enough.



We want people who have **initiative, ambition and drive.**



We want someone who wakes up thinking:



**"How can I become better today?"**



Someone who sees a problem and tries to solve it.



Someone who finds a new interest and shares it.



Someone who discovers a better workflow and tells the team.



Someone who learns from mistakes.



Someone who wants to understand the business more deeply.



Someone who wants to grow their responsibilities.



Someone who wants to make more money by becoming more valuable.



That is the type of person we want.



---



# THIS IS A REPETITIVE ROLE — BUT THERE IS A LOT OF ROOM TO GROW



We want to be transparent.



You will be creating campaigns every week.



You may create:



**Campaign 1 ? Campaign 2 ? Campaign 3 ? Campaign 4...**



There is repetition.



But if you are someone who becomes extremely good at this role, there is **no fixed ceiling on your growth.**



We want to reward people who become valuable to the company.



If you consistently:



* Make zero mistakes

* Work quickly

* Improve your skills

* Take initiative

* Find better targeting

* Help improve our systems

* Help other team members

* Take responsibility

* Become an expert in your department

* Contribute to the company's growth



Then your salary can continue increasing.



**There is no fixed salary ceiling for exceptional performers.**



---



# WE WANT LONG-TERM PEOPLE



This is not a job for someone who wants to stay for a few months and move on.



We are looking for someone who wants to build something with us.



We want someone who:



* Wants to stay long-term.

* Wants to become better.

* Wants to take on more responsibility.

* Wants to grow financially.

* Wants to grow professionally.

* Cares about the company's success.

* Understands the vision of the owners.

* Wants to help the people around them improve.



If the company grows and you grow with it, **we want your compensation to grow with you.**



---



# WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE



Your daily work will be structured around campaign production.



You will receive your assigned product links.



You will:



**Open ? Study ? Download ? Research ? Build ? Check ? Submit**



You will work through your assigned products systematically.



The goal is to complete your campaigns efficiently while maintaining **extremely high accuracy.**



We would rather have someone who is slightly slower and makes **zero mistakes** than someone who works extremely fast and constantly creates problems.



Over time, however, we expect you to become:



**Faster + Better + More Accurate**



---



# ZERO-MISTAKE MINDSET



Accuracy is extremely important.



You will be working with real advertising campaigns and real advertising budgets.



You need to carefully check:



* Correct product

* Correct images

* Correct campaign

* Correct targeting

* Correct interests

* Correct budget

* Correct URL

* Correct Pixel

* Correct
 Page

* Correct Instagram account

* Correct campaign structure

* Correct naming

* Correct settings



Before you submit anything, **you check your own work.**



We expect you to develop a personal quality-control system so mistakes become extremely rare.



Our goal is:



## **40 CAMPAIGNS PER WEEK + EXTREMELY HIGH ACCURACY**



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Reliable computer.

* **MacBook is strongly preferred.**

*
 account.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Smartphone.

* Quiet workspace suitable for full-time remote work.

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM.



---



# SALARY & CAREER GROWTH



## **STARTING SALARY: $600 USD/MONTH**



After your first **3 months**, your performance will be reviewed and **your salary will be increased based on your performance.**



Your future salary increases can be based on:



* Accuracy

* Speed

* Initiative

* Reliability

* Quality of work

* Knowledge

* Improvement

* Contribution to the team

* Ability to take on more responsibility

* Helping others improve

* Overall value to the company



There is **no fixed salary ceiling** for someone who becomes extremely valuable.



If you become one of the best people in your department, we want your compensation to reflect that.



We believe:



**The better you become ? the more valuable you become ? the more you can earn.**



We are willing to continue increasing compensation for people who consistently work hard, improve, take ownership and contribute to the company's growth.



This is a **full-time, long-term position.**



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



Do not apply if:



* You have less than 2–3 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

* You have never personally created Meta campaigns.

* You don't understand Meta Ads Manager.

* You only have theoretical knowledge.

* Your Meta Ads experience is outdated.

* You are looking for beginner training.

* You don't understand
 interests and targeting.

* You don't know how to research audiences.

* You are uncomfortable creating approximately 40 campaigns every week.

* You don't like repetitive work.

* You work without paying attention to details.

* You regularly make avoidable mistakes.

* You need someone to tell you every step.

* You are not proactive.

* You don't communicate well.

* You are not interested in learning.

* You don't want to grow professionally.

* You are looking for a short-term job.

* You are only interested in collecting a salary.

* You don't have ambition to become better and earn more.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject:



**META CAMPAIGN SETUP – [Your Name]**



Please answer **ALL** questions.



Applications with incomplete, generic or low-effort answers will not be reviewed.



### 1. EXPERIENCE



How many years of hands-on Meta Ads experience do you have?



Approximately how many Meta campaigns have you personally created?



What types of products or businesses have you advertised?



---



### 2. CAMPAIGN SETUP



Imagine you receive a Shopify product page that has already been approved for advertising.



Walk us through **exactly what you would do from the moment you receive the link until the campaign is ready to launch.**



List the steps in order.



---



### 3. INTEREST RESEARCH



Imagine we give you a men's clothing product.



Explain how you would research and choose the **Meta interests** you would use for the campaign.



We want to understand how you think about audiences.



---



### 4. QUALITY CONTROL



Before submitting a campaign for launch, what are the **five most important things** you personally check?



Explain why each one matters.



---



### 5. HIGH-VOLUME WORKFLOW



You receive **40 new product links** for the week.



How would you organize your work to complete all 40 campaigns on time while maintaining extremely high accuracy?



---



### 6. INITIATIVE



Tell us about a time when you personally found a better way to perform a task, improve a campaign, research an audience or improve a workflow.

What was the result?

### 7. META ADS — CURRENT KNOWLEDGE

### 8. CAREER & AMBITION

What skills do you want to develop?



What would make you want to stay with a company long-term?

# IMPORTANT

If you have real Meta Ads experience, understand current
 advertising, have strong knowledge of interests and targeting, communicate excellent English, have initiative and genuinely want to grow:

# AI Video Creative Specialist – Direct Response Dropshipping Ads



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**

**Salary review and increase after 3 months based on performance**



**Schedule: Monday – Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Full-Time**



---



## About Us



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



We are **not a traditional e-commerce brand**.



Our business model is based on constantly researching, testing and scaling new products through paid advertising.



Every week, our team identifies products with potential.



We provide the products, the target audiences and the information you need.



Your job is to take those products and audiences and create **high-converting video advertising creatives** specifically for
 and Instagram.



This is a **direct-response advertising position**.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to make beautiful videos.



We need someone who understands:



**Product + Audience + Marketing Angle + Creative + Conversion**



The purpose of every video is ultimately to **make the customer want the product and take action.**



---



# THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL VIDEO EDITING JOB



This is extremely important.



We are **not hiring someone to make nice-looking videos just for the sake of making videos.**



We need someone who understands how to use video to **market and sell products.**



A beautiful video that gets attention but does not make someone interested in buying is not a successful creative for us.



You need to understand:



* Who the target customer is

* What the customer wants

* What problem or desire the product addresses

* What angle will attract that customer

* What will make someone stop scrolling

* How to present the product quickly

* How to create desire

* How to make the product look appealing

* How to create a reason to continue watching

* How to turn attention into purchasing intent



You are creating **advertising creatives**, not entertainment content.



---



# YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Every week, our team will provide you with new products that have **potential to be scaled through paid advertising**.



We will also provide information about the target audiences we are testing.



You will be responsible for understanding the product and audience and creating multiple AI-powered video creatives designed specifically to attract those customers.



Videos will generally be:



**12–15 seconds long.**



Your target production volume will be approximately:



**20+ usable advertising creatives per day.**



The objective is to give our Meta Ads team a large number of strong creatives that they can test and use to identify winning angles.



---



# WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities include:



* Create 20+ usable video advertising creatives per day.

* Create videos specifically for *
 and Instagram advertising**.

* Study the product before creating the creative.

* Understand the target audience for each product.

* Develop different marketing angles for the same product.

* Use AI tools to create product-focused videos.

* Create different hooks and concepts.

* Create different visual presentations of the same product.

* Create videos designed to stop the scroll.

* Create videos designed to generate purchasing interest.

* Keep the product as the main focus.

* Make sure the product remains accurate and recognizable.

* Review every video before submission.

* Organize completed creatives properly.

* Communicate constantly with the team.

* Work quickly and efficiently.

* Continuously improve your production workflow.

* Research new AI tools and techniques that can improve our creative output.



---



# YOU MUST UNDERSTAND DROPSHIPPING ADVERTISING



We want someone who understands the difference between **traditional e-commerce/brand marketing and direct-response dropshipping.**



We are constantly testing new products.



We are not creating months of content around one established brand identity.



A product can be discovered today, tested through advertising, and potentially scaled rapidly if the numbers show that customers want it.



That means our creative team needs to be extremely adaptable.



You may work on:



* A jacket today

* A men's shirt tomorrow

* A completely different men's product next week



You must be able to quickly understand:



**What is this product?**



**Who would buy it?**



**Why would they want it?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What angle would make them interested?**



**How can we communicate that visually in 12–15 seconds?**



That is the skill we are looking for.



---



# META ADS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have real experience creating *
 and Instagram advertising creatives.**



We are not interested in applicants whose primary experience is:



* YouTube videos

* Entertainment content

* General social media videos

* Wedding videos

* Corporate videos

* Cinematic filmmaking

* Traditional video editing without advertising experience



Your experience must be directly relevant to **performance advertising**.



You should understand how
/Instagram users behave and how creative affects advertising performance.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Scroll-stopping hooks

* Product-focused creatives

* Creative angles

* Audience psychology

* Desire and purchasing intent

* Product benefits

* Problem/solution angles

* Curiosity

* Visual demonstrations

* Creative testing

* Direct-response advertising



---



# YOU NEED TO THINK LIKE A MARKETER



This is one of the most important requirements.



Before creating a video, you should be asking yourself:



**Who am I making this video for?**



**What does this person care about?**



**Why would they want this product?**



**What would make them stop scrolling?**



**What visual would make them interested?**



**What would make them want to see the product?**



**What would make them want to buy it?**

We want someone who thinks:



**"I understand the audience. I understand the product. Now how do I create a creative that converts?"**



---



# AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have professional experience using AI video-generation tools.



You should be comfortable with:



* Image-to-video

* AI video generation

* Product animation

* AI-generated environments

* Scene generation

* Product-focused video generation

* Creative variations

* Video enhancement

* Rapid creative production



You are not required to use any particular platform.



In fact, we prefer someone who is constantly researching and discovering **new and better AI tools.**



If a new AI video platform comes out that can make our production faster or better, we want you to be the person who discovers it and brings it to the team.



---



# EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have:



* **2–4+ years of professional video/advertising experience**

* Real experience creating *
 and Instagram video ads**

* Experience creating direct-response advertising creatives

* Strong understanding of marketing products through video

* Professional AI video-generation experience

* Strong understanding of audience and customer psychology

* Ability to create multiple creative concepts quickly

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organization skills

* Excellent communication

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to learn new tools quickly



**This is an expert-level position.**



If you are still learning the basics of AI video creation or advertising, please do not apply.



---



# WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO IS:



### FAST



You understand that we test products and creatives at high volume.



You need to consistently produce **20+ usable creatives per day.**



### CREATIVE



You can take one product and develop multiple completely different advertising angles.



### MARKETING-MINDED



You understand that the objective is not simply to make a good-looking video.



The objective is to **sell the product.**



### PROACTIVE



You don't wait for someone to tell you every step.



You research new tools.



You test new techniques.



You bring ideas.



You find ways to make the workflow faster and better.



### ORGANIZED



You can manage multiple products, creative concepts and files without creating confusion.



### COMMUNICATIVE



We work as a team.



Constant communication is important.



If something isn't clear, ask.



If you have an idea, share it.



If you find a better way, tell us.



### AMBITIOUS



We want someone who wants to grow professionally and financially.



We are building a company where people who become more skilled, more productive and more valuable can take on more responsibility and earn more.



### ENERGETIC



We want someone who has energy, initiative and a genuine desire to improve their life and career.



This is a fast-moving company.



We need people who want to move forward with us.



---



# HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS



Our process is straightforward.



### STEP 1 — PRODUCT



Our research team identifies products with potential to be scaled.



We provide you with the product.



### STEP 2 — AUDIENCE



We provide information about the audience we are targeting.



You need to understand that audience.



### STEP 3 — CREATIVE STRATEGY



You determine how the product should be presented to that audience.



You develop different hooks, angles and concepts.



### STEP 4 — PRODUCTION



You use AI and your video-production skills to create approximately **20+ creatives per day.**



Each video is approximately **12–15 seconds.**



### STEP 5 — QUALITY CONTROL



You review every creative.



The product must remain accurate.



The video must make sense.



There must be no obvious AI errors.



The creative must be suitable for advertising.



### STEP 6 — SUBMISSION



You organize and submit the completed creatives to our Meta Ads team.



The advertising team then tests the creatives.



---



# PRODUCT ACCURACY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



AI can create incredible visuals, but it can also distort products.



You must have an extremely strong eye for detail.



You need to catch:



* Incorrect product colors

* Product shape changing

* Missing buttons

* Incorrect details

* Distorted clothing

* Incorrect logos

* Unrealistic movements

* Product changing between scenes

* AI artifacts

* Product becoming unrecognizable



We are selling the actual product.



The creative must represent the actual product accurately.



---



# SALARY & CAREER GROWTH



**Starting Salary: $700 USD/month**



After your first **3 months**, your performance will be reviewed and your salary will be increased based on your performance.



Your growth will depend on:



* Quality

* Speed

* Reliability

* Creative performance

* Initiative

* Communication

* Skill development

* Ability to take on more responsibility

* Contribution to the company's growth



We want people who grow with us.



If you become faster, better, more creative and more valuable to the company, your compensation and responsibilities can increase accordingly.



This is intended to be a **long-term position.**



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Reliable MacBook or high-performance computer

* Smartphone

* Fast and reliable internet

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM

* Access to the AI/video tools required for your workflow



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



Do not apply if:



* You have never created AI videos.

* You have no experience creating advertising creatives.

* You have never created
/Instagram video ads.

* Your experience is mainly YouTube.

* Your experience is mainly entertainment content.

* You are only a traditional video editor.

* You don't have a strong desire to grow professionally.



---



# HOW TO APPLY

title: Performance Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Meta & App Growth
description:
Send your proposed price and estimated duration for this project.



We are looking for a highly skilled Performance Marketing / Paid Acquisition Specialist to help grow InfoAlanya, a travel and local-services app for people visiting or living in Alanya, Turkey.



This is NOT a social media posting/content role. 



We are looking for someone who is obsessed with:



Finding the cheapest relevant traffic

Lowering Cost Per Install (CPI)

Lowering Cost Per Acquisition / Booking (CPA)

Finding profitable countries, languages and keywords

Tracking actual bookings — not likes or vanity metrics

Testing and scaling what works

About InfoAlanya



InfoAlanya is an app where users can find and book many different things related to Alanya, including:



Airport transfers

Tours and excursions

Restaurants

Beauty clinics/salons

Dental clinics

Local businesses

Activities

Useful tourist information

Pharmacy/emergency information

And other local services



This means we are interested not only in obvious commercial keywords such as:



Alanya tours

Alanya diving

Alanya airport transfer

Dentist Alanya

Alanya hamam



We are also interested in finding very cheap “gateway keywords” such as:



Emergency pharmacy Alanya

Alanya weather

Alanya markets

Alanya beaches

Alanya bus

Things to do in Alanya



A person may enter InfoAlanya for one reason and later purchase another service.



The Main Goal



Your job is to answer one question:



How can we acquire the highest number of valuable InfoAlanya users and bookings for the lowest possible advertising cost?



We want to systematically test:



Google Search

Google App campaigns

Meta /
 / Instagram

Potentially TikTok

Different countries

Different languages

Different keyword groups

Different ad creatives

Different landing/app-store flows



Markets may include:



Denmark

Norway

Sweden

Germany

Poland

UK

Turkey

Netherlands

Other relevant Alanya tourism markets



We do NOT assume Denmark will necessarily be the cheapest market.



We want data to tell us where to spend our money.



Google Ads / Keyword Research



A major part of this role will be identifying opportunities that competitors may be overlooking.



We want someone who can research hundreds of Alanya-related searches and identify combinations of:



Low CPC + relevant user + reasonable search volume + potential lifetime customer value.



You should be comfortable using:



Google Keyword Planner

Google Ads

Search Terms reports

Semrush/Ahrefs or similar tools where useful

Negative keywords

Exact / phrase / broad match strategy

Search-intent analysis

Country/language segmentation



We want keyword research performed separately for different languages and countries.



For example, the same intention should potentially be researched in:



Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, German, Polish, English and Turkish.



Tracking Is Extremely Important



We do not want to optimize only for clicks.



We want to track the complete funnel:



Ad ? App Store / Google Play ? Install ? App Open ? Account Created ? Product Viewed ? Booking Started ? Booking Completed ? Booking Value



You should understand app conversion tracking and be able to work with our mobile/backend developers to define the correct events.



Experience with tools such as Meta SDK, Google Analytics/Firebase, Google Ads conversion tracking and app attribution is highly valuable.



What We Want From You



We do NOT want you simply to launch campaigns and spend our budget.



We want continuous testing.



For every campaign we should be able to see:



Advertising spend

Impressions

Clicks

CPC

App installs

CPI

Accounts created

Bookings

CPA / Cost per Booking

Booking revenue

Estimated profit

ROAS

Country

Language

Keyword/ad responsible for the result



If one market gives us customers for €8 and another gives us customers for €25, we want budget moved toward the €8 market.



If a keyword produces cheap clicks but no valuable users, we stop it.



If an unexpected keyword produces profitable users, we scale it.



IMPORTANT – Please Answer These Questions When Applying



Generic applications will not be considered.



1. Price and Duration



Please state:



Your total project price or hourly rate

Estimated number of hours

Estimated duration to complete the initial setup, research and launch

2. €1,000 Test



Imagine InfoAlanya gives you an initial advertising budget of €1,000.



Explain exactly how you would use the first €1,000.



Which platforms would you test?



Which countries?



How much would you allocate to each?



Why?



3. Keyword Opportunity



Give us at least 10 Alanya-related keyword ideas or keyword groups you would investigate.



We specifically want to know how you would find:



cheap keywords that still bring potentially valuable InfoAlanya users.



Explain how you would determine:



Search volume

CPC

Competition

Intent

Potential customer value

4. Country Testing



How would you determine whether it is cheaper for us to acquire a customer from:



Denmark vs Norway vs Germany vs Poland vs Turkey?



Do not answer only based on CPM.



Explain how you would measure the actual winning market.



5. Cheap Traffic vs Valuable Traffic



Suppose:



Keyword A costs €0.10 per click.



Keyword B costs €1.50 per click.



How would you determine which one is actually better for InfoAlanya?



6. App Tracking



Explain how you would track:



Ad ? Install ? Registration ? Booking ? Booking Value.



What needs to be implemented by you, and what would you need from our developers?



7. Show Real Results



Please show us one real campaign you personally managed.



Tell us:



Platform

Industry

Ad spend

CPC

CPA

Conversion rate

ROAS if applicable

What you changed to improve performance



Screenshots with confidential client information hidden are welcome.



8. Scaling



If you discovered that we could consistently spend €10 to acquire a booking that generates significantly more gross profit than the advertising cost, how would you scale from €500/month to €5,000–€10,000/month without destroying the CPA?



Required Experience



You should have strong experience with several of the following:



Google Ads

Google Search Ads

Google Keyword Planner

Meta Ads

Mobile app advertising

Conversion tracking

Firebase / GA4

Meta Pixel / SDK / Conversions API

Retargeting

Custom audiences

A/B testing

Keyword research

International advertising

Multi-language campaigns

CPA / ROAS optimization



Travel, tourism, marketplace, booking or mobile-app experience is a major advantage.



Working Arrangement



We initially want someone to:



Audit our setup

Create the tracking/measurement plan

Work with our developers on correct tracking

Perform detailed keyword and market research

Set up the first campaigns

Run controlled tests

Optimize based on bookings/profit

Teach us how the setup works



This may initially be a project/setup role rather than a permanent full-time position.



If you produce excellent results, there is significant potential for ongoing work and increasing advertising budgets.



Important



We are looking for a performance marketer, not someone whose main expertise is social media posting, Canva, followers or engagement.



Our primary success metrics are:



Cost per Install ? Cost per Customer ? Profit ? Scale



Start your application with the words:



ALANYA GROWTH



Then answer all questions above.



Applications that do not include price, estimated hours and duration will not be considered.

We are looking for a Sales Virtual Assistant to support a growing property company with lead follow-up, appointment booking, CRM updates, and client communication.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident speaking to people, organised, quick to respond, and comfortable handling property-related enquiries in a professional way.



Role Overview



As a Sales VA, your main responsibility is to help turn new enquiries into booked calls, viewings, or qualified opportunities. You will be the first point of contact for many leads, so your communication needs to be clear, polite, confident, and persistent without being pushy.



You will work closely with the sales/property team to make sure every lead is followed up properly, logged correctly, and moved through the pipeline.



Key Responsibilities

- Lead Follow-Up

- Respond to new leads from
, website forms, WhatsApp,
, property portals, and CRM systems.

 leads quickly after they enquire.

title: E-Commerce Customer Support & Order Fulfillment Specialist
description:
We sell tonneau covers and truck bed accessories to customers in the US. People ask lots of questions before they buy: will this fit my truck, what's the difference between these two covers, when will it get here etc.



You are the person who answers them, and who makes sure every order that comes in lands correctly.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

-Place customer orders through our distributor portals

-Update tracking numbers as soon as they are available

-Answer live chat, confirm fitment (year, make, model, bed size), and respond to new leads within 1 to 2 minutes

-Help customers with existing orders: returns, missing parts, shipping issues

-Answer order support calls and drive them to resolution

-Answer sales calls and give real product advice, once you know our catalog well (the owner handles these for your first few weeks)

-Keep everything organized in our CRM

-There will be some other minor tasks you will do not listed as well.



REQUIREMENTS:

-Available from 9:00AM - 5:00PM MST 

-Clear, neutral American accent. You will be on the phone with US customers daily

-2+ years in customer support, including phone

-Experience supporting US customers

-Shopify experience

-CRM experience (any platform)

-Internet 60 Mbps or faster

-Looking for a long-term role, 2+ years

-Basic knowledge using AI tools 



We are preferably looking for someone that has had previous experience with a auto parts store and Vehicle fitment knowledge and will pay more if qualified. 



We expect this to be your only job during M-F 9:00AM- 5:00PM MST. No other clients, freelance or employed.





If you currently have another client, tell us in your application. It will not automatically disqualify you, and we can talk about timing. Not telling us will.



PAY AND TERMS:

-$700 to $1,040 USD/month, based on experience

-Paid twice monthly via Wise



HOW TO APPLY



Please write this application yourself. We use AI tools here every day, so this is not about that. For this one we want to hear how you actually think and write. Your English does not have to be perfect. If we detect AI in your resume it's an automatic disqualification



1. Start your message with: TBB-2026-Application



2. In your first two sentences, name one tonneau cover brand you found on our website, and tell us what you think our typical customer is worried about before they buy. (
)



3. Answer these questions, numbered, in order:



-What hours (in Philippine time) are you available to work, and what other commitments do you have during any part of a 24-hour day? Please list all of them, including part-time, project-based, study, and family business.



-Describe the last e-commerce store you supported. What platform, what was your weekly responsibility, and what happened to that role?



-A customer
s: "The cover I got doesn't fit my 2019 Silverado 5.8ft bed, I want a refund." In 3 to 4 sentences, what do you do first and why?



-What is your internet provider and speed? Do you have a backup connection and backup power?



-What is your target monthly salary in USD, and what would make you leave a job?



4. Record a short video, 60 seconds or less. Do not script it. Just answer this one question:



-Walk me through what you did yesterday, hour by hour, from when you started work to when you finished.



5. Attach your resume and include a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile.



Applications missing any of these five steps will not be reviewed.

title: HIRING: 2 EDITORS — 2 MONTHS OF TRAINING BEFORE YOU START
description:
Read this whole thing. If you can't get through a job post, you won't get through the training.



What this actually is



We run an e-commerce brand that lives and dies by video. Your job: take a script, and turn it into a video that makes people stop scrolling and start buying — using AI tools to build the visuals and b-roll.



No AI experience needed. We'll teach you that part from zero. But you need basic editing skills already. If you've never touched a timeline, this isn't for you yet.



Here's the deal



We're taking 2 people, training them ourselves, and turning them into editors who are genuinely hard to replace. The kind that agencies fight over.



That's the offer. Here's the price:



2 months. Intensive. Minimum 8 hours a day.



You get paid during training — a small amount, not a salary. Because during those two months you're not producing for us, you're becoming someone. We're spending our time on you, and we only spend it on people who show up.



Every week, you'll be tested on what you learned that week. Pass and you move forward. Fail and you're out. That's not us being harsh — that's us being honest with you about what this work actually demands.



Who we want



Someone who wants to be good, not just employed

Someone who can block out 8 hours a day and actually protect that time

Someone who takes feedback and immediately applies it

Someone smart, hungry, and willing



Who we don't want



If you already know you'll quit when it gets hard — don't apply. Save your time and mine.



What's on the other side



Real skills. A real seat in a company that's growing. And money that most people your age don't come close to.



How to apply



Comment READY — then tell me in a few lines why it should be you.



That's it. Two spots.

title: Social Media & Video Editor — Vermont Historic Inn (Long-Term, 30 hrs/wk)
description:
TITLE: Social Media & Video Editor — Vermont Historic Inn (Long-Term, 20-40 hrs/wk)



We are a 16-room historic inn in Vermont, USA with three businesses (2 distinct social media brands):

1. Art studio running painting workshops, 

2. Lodging/events business,

3. Restaurant + tavern



We have raw footage and photos piling up and no time to edit them. 



Also need you to take the lead crafting a monthly calendar of posts and reels, post this as our social media manager, and responding to DMs and comments and providing us updates and raising any we need to address.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn our raw phone footage + photos into 4-6 finished Reels per week

- Write captions in our voice (warm, real, not salesy — we'll train you)

- Schedule and publish across IG, FB, TikTok, Google Business Profile

- Organize and tag our photo/video library so nothing gets lost

- Build a simple monthly content calendar we approve

- Light community management (comments, saved DMs for us to answer)



YOU MUST HAVE

- Video editing platform — strong short-form editing

- Canva expertise for integrating with our brand materials and developing carousels, etc

- Excellent written English (you're writing our captions, in our voice)

- Real portfolio of Reels/TikToks you edited from someone else's raw footage

- Reliable internet (50 Mbps+) and a machine that handles 4K

- Organized. We will send you messy folders. You will make them clean.



NICE TO HAVE

- Hospitality, travel, food, or lifestyle brand experience



PAY: $
USD/month depending on experience and hours (20-40/week). Assuming we establish a good long term working relationship, possible for 13th month bonus and paid time off in the future. We want someone for years, not months.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, we only review applications that follow this:

1. Subject line: LANDGROVE — [Your Name]

2. Link to 3 Reels you personally edited. Say what the raw footage was.

3. In 3 sentences: what would you ask us to shoot at a 200-year-old country in Vermont in October?

4. Your last two roles with USD rate and hours (e.g., $6/hr full-time).



Up to four shortlisted applicants get a PAID trial: we send 20 raw clips, you send back 3 finished Reels with captions. $50 for the trial.

title: Moving Consultant
