title: Facebook Ads Launcher - Execution only
description:
We’re a multi-brand e-commerce company running paid
 ad campaigns across several stores. We’re looking for someone to **launch
 ads in Ads Manager** based on instructions provided by our team.



That’s it.



This is a **long-term opportunity**, not a quick gig or one-off job. We’re hiring for consistency, reliability, and fast execution, with the goal of building a lasting working relationship.



## What You’ll Do



* Download creative + copy from a shared folder

* Copy/paste the provided ad copy into Ads Manager

* Upload the creative

* Set targeting, budget, and other settings exactly as instructed

* Review everything for accuracy

* Launch the ads



## What You Will NOT Do



* No ad killing or pausing

* No optimization

* No media buying decisions

* No strategy

* No creative edits

* No copywriting or copy edits



This is a **pure execution role**.



If you’re looking for a media buyer position where you’ll be making optimization or strategy decisions, this is **not** the position for you.



## Schedule & Availability



You must be **available every day of the week, Monday through Sunday**.



We may send ads to be launched on **any day of the week**, and you must be able to **launch them the same day they are assigned**.



Fast turnaround is extremely important for this role.



Current workload is approximately **1–2 hours per day when launches are required**, but this can increase to **2–4+ hours as our ad volume and number of brands grow**.



Your daily workload may vary. Some days may have fewer ads, while other days may have significantly more.



## Requirements — ALL Mandatory



* Prior experience launching
 ads directly inside Meta Ads Manager

* Available **7 days per week**

* Able to launch ads **the same day they are assigned**

* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts and brands

* Able to follow detailed instructions exactly without making unauthorized changes

* Reliable and responsive

* Very detail-oriented — mistakes with URLs, copy, creative, budgets, targeting, naming, or settings are not acceptable

* Able to work quickly while maintaining accuracy

* Looking for a **long-term commitment**, not a short-term or one-time gig

* Rate is **$3/hour** — you must be completely comfortable with this rate before applying



## To Apply



Use the subject line:



**“I meet all requirements”**



Only use this subject line if you **100% meet every requirement above**.



In your application:



1. Confirm **one by one** that you meet EACH requirement listed above.

   No partial matches, no “I can adjust my schedule,” and no exceptions.



2. Tell me:



   * Approximately how many
 ads you have launched

   * How many different ad accounts/brands you have worked with

   * How long you have been doing this type of work



3. Explain what your previous ad-launching process looked like from the moment you received the creative/copy until the ad was published.



4. Answer this in **one sentence only**:



**What is the difference between a campaign, an ad set, and an ad?**



**Do not use ChatGPT or AI to write your application or answer the question above. Generic or AI-generated applications will be rejected.**

title: Creator Acquisition & Influencer Seeding Manager
description:
CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS & INFLUENCER SEEDING SPECIALIST



Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for an experienced Creator Partnerships & Influencer Seeding Specialist to help us aggressively grow awareness of our brand through TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms.



Our goal is to build a creator outreach system capable of getting My Moss products into the hands of hundreds of qualified U.S.-based creators every week and continue scaling from there.



This is NOT a general social media management position.



Your primary responsibility will be to find great creators, contact them, build relationships, get them interested in trying our products and coordinate product seeding at scale.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



* Find and research creators on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms

* Identify health, wellness, fitness, lifestyle, food, beauty and related creators who are a strong fit for My Moss

* Build and maintain a large database of qualified creators

* Contact creators through
, Instagram DM, TikTok and other appropriate channels

* Personalize outreach instead of sending obvious spam

* Follow up consistently with creators who do not initially respond

* Communicate with creators who are interested in receiving product

* Collect creator shipping information and product or flavor preferences

* Coordinate sample shipments with our internal team

* Track every creator from initial contact through product delivery and content creation

* Follow up with creators after they receive the product

* Encourage creators to post authentic content featuring the products

* Identify high-performing creators for longer-term partnerships and affiliate opportunities

* Recruit creators into our affiliate program when appropriate

* Monitor creator posts, views, engagement and resulting sales

* Research competitor brands and identify creators already producing relevant content

* Continuously find new creator niches and outreach opportunities

* Maintain organized Google Sheets or CRM records

* Provide weekly performance reports



THE GOAL



We want to build a large creator acquisition system capable of sending products to hundreds of qualified creators every week and eventually scaling well beyond that.



However, we care about quality as much as volume.



We DO NOT want random influencers simply because they have followers.



We want creators whose:



* Audience fits our target customer

* Content quality is strong

* Engagement appears genuine

* Audience is primarily U.S.-based

* Content is relevant to health, wellness, lifestyle, fitness, food, beauty or related interests

* Posting history shows that they actually create product-related content



Micro-creators are welcome and encouraged.



Someone with 8,000 highly engaged followers may be far more valuable to us than someone with 200,000 disengaged followers.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO



* Has previous experience with influencer outreach or creator seeding

* Understands TikTok and Instagram creator culture

* Can identify strong creators quickly

* Has excellent written English

* Is comfortable communicating with U.S.-based creators

* Is persistent without being annoying or spammy

* Understands follow-up and relationship building

* Is highly organized

* Can handle hundreds of creator conversations at once

* Can work independently without waiting for instructions every day

* Understands influencer marketing metrics

* Has experience with creator databases, CRM systems or spreadsheets

* Understands affiliate marketing or creator partnerships

* Understands how to build and improve a creator outreach funnel

* Can help us scale the system over time



Experience working with health, wellness, supplements, food, beauty or consumer packaged goods brands is strongly preferred.



THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF



* Your strategy is simply mass-DMing random influencers

* You judge creators entirely by follower count

* You have never managed creator outreach before

* You cannot show examples of previous creator campaigns

* You need to be told exactly what to do every day

* You do not track your work

* You send generic copy-and-paste outreach without researching the creator

* You do not understand how to measure response rates, acceptance rates and posting rates



We are trying to build a creator acquisition machine, not simply send DMs.



METRICS WE WILL TRACK



Your performance will be measured using metrics including:



* Qualified creators researched

* Creators contacted

* Response rate

* Positive response rate

* Creators agreeing to receive product

* Samples shipped

* Cost per creator acquired

* Creators who post

* Posting rate

* Content generated

* Views and engagement generated

* Affiliate creators recruited

* Sales generated where trackable



PAID SKILLS TEST



Strong applicants will be invited to complete a short paid test project before we make our final hiring decision.



You will be given information about our company and products.



Your assignment will be to:



PART 1 - CREATOR RESEARCH



Find 25 U.S.-based creators that you believe would be strong candidates to receive My Moss products.



For each creator provide:



* Creator name

* TikTok, Instagram or YouTube profile

* Follower count

* Approximate engagement

* Average recent views if available

* Content niche

* Contact information if publicly available

* Why you selected them

* Which My Moss product or flavor you think would fit their content

* How likely you believe they are to accept free product

* How likely you believe they are to actually create content



PART 2 - RANKING



Rank your Top 10 creators from the list and explain why you believe they are the strongest opportunities.



We want to understand how you think, not simply whether you can find influencers.



PART 3 - OUTREACH



Write personalized outreach messages for 5 of the creators you selected.



The messages should demonstrate that you actually reviewed their content.



PART 4 - STRATEGY



Give us a short plan explaining how you would build our creator seeding program into a large-scale system capable of getting products into the hands of hundreds of qualified creators every week.



Include:



* How many creators you would research weekly

* How many creators you would contact weekly

* Your expected response rate

* Your expected positive response rate

* Your expected sample acceptance rate

* Your expected posting rate

* Your follow-up process

* How you would track creators

* What tools you would use

* How you would improve performance over time

* How you would eventually scale the operation to thousands of creator contacts per week



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe your previous influencer or creator outreach experience.

3. Tell us approximately how many creators you have personally contacted or managed.

4. Tell us the largest creator seeding campaign you have worked on.

5. Provide examples of brands or campaigns you have worked with.

6. What percentage of creators you contacted typically responded?

7. What percentage of creators you contacted typically agreed to receive products?

8. What percentage of creators who received products actually posted content?

9. What tools have you used for influencer discovery and outreach?

10. What platforms are you strongest with - TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or others?

11. Describe how you determine whether a creator is actually worth sending free product to.

12. Have you worked with TikTok Shop affiliates or affiliate creators?

13. Have you ever helped scale a creator outreach operation?

14. What would you focus on during your first 30 days with Natural Renewals?

15. Tell us your expected monthly salary.



At the very beginning of your application, write:



CREATOR MACHINE



Applications that do not include these words will not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in growing with us long term. Strong performance can lead to increased compensation, additional responsibility and eventually management of a larger creator outreach team.

title: Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads)
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta Ads) 



Remote (Australia-based or able to work AEST hours)



Part Time (Full Time Option)



About us

We are  a boutique performance marketing agency who does lead gen & e-commerce brands that are ready to scale properly, not just spend morey on Ads



We're not a churn-and-burn agency with 60 accounts and a junior on every one of them. We run a tight, high-touch client roster where every account gets senior attention, real strategy, and a full-funnel view:



The founder has 7 years in direct-response marketer who still writes copy and reviews ad accounts. Standards are high at our agency



Over the next few years we're building the agency that ambitious  founders come to when they want a partner, not a vendor: fewer clients, deeper work, better results, and a team that runs the accounts like they own them. This role is a cornerstone of that.



The Role

You'll own paid social performance across a portfolio of client accounts, end to end. Not "manage" it. Own it.



That means:

- Building and running Paid Meta Ads campaigns from strategy through to scaling: account structure, audiences, testing frameworks, budget allocation, and optimisation

- Owning creative strategy: writing briefs, identifying winning angles and hooks, and killing losers fast

- You will be required to make creatives but not to edit any videos (we have a full time editor for that)

- Analysing performance daily and knowing why something is working or not

- Reporting to the founder, what happened, what we're doing about it, and what's next

- Handling technical setup: Pixel, CAPI, event tracking, Ads Manager hygiene, and troubleshooting when things break

- Contributing to landing page and funnel recommendations, because the ad is only half the job

- Building repeatable systems (testing SOPs, naming conventions, reporting templates) so the agency gets stronger every month



Optional but valued: running Google Ads or Tiktok ads or being able to build funnels.

You'll work directly with the founder and our team. Once you're up and running, you'll be trusted with senior client relationships and increasing autonomy over your book of accounts.







Who You Are

- 2+ years hands-on Meta Ads media buying, ideally in an agency 

- You've personally managed both small and big accounts (ad spend) and can talk fluently about what you did with it and what happened

- Strong direct-response instincts: you understand hooks, offers, angles and creative iteration, not just bid strategies

title: Paid Marketing & Growth Manager - Meta and Google expert wanted: own the paid budget for two UK jewellery brands
description:
About us

We are Lily Charmed and Scream Pretty, two UK jewellery brands run by the same small, fast-moving team.



Lily Charmed is a charm jewellery brand built on sentiment and storytelling. Our customers are charm collectors and gift buyers.

Scream Pretty is a bold, curated ear jewellery brand. Mostly self-purchase, with a strong gifting element.



We sell direct to consumers on Shopify, wholesale to jewellers, department stores, gift boutiques and hotels, and on marketplaces including Amazon, Etsy, Wolf & Badger and Not On The High Street.



We are a lean team that uses AI and automation heavily. We would rather run a smart system than a big department. That means this role has real budget authority and real ownership from day one.





Job description

We are looking for a paid marketing manager to own our Meta and Google advertising across both brands, plus the creator programme that feeds it, plus the reporting rhythm that keeps the whole marketing function honest.



Our margins are tight and our budget is not enormous. We need someone who treats every pound like it is their own, kills what is not working quickly, and can tell us clearly why performance moved. If you like being handed a budget and being held to a number, this is a good job. If you prefer to set things live and hope, it is not.





Your responsibilities

1. Meta advertising



Campaign and ad set build for both brands

Ad copy and creative production in Canva from our brand kits

Weekly optimisation, adjustments and budget updates

Audience updating in platform, plus custom audiences pulled from Klaviyo and Shopify

Product feed updates and troubleshooting

Monthly reporting



2. Google advertising



Google Merchant Centre feed management and issue resolution, including adding new products, currently a manual process

Campaign, ad group and asset build

Negative keyword review

Weekly optimisation, adjustments and budget updates

Sitelink, ad copy and promotion updates

Custom audience updating from Klaviyo and Shopify

Monthly reporting



Pinterest advertising is currently paused and may be reactivated.



3. Budget and performance



Manage the monthly advertising budget set by our Operations Director

Report on best performing creative, demographic and audience profiling, ROAS and CPA

Build and run an ad creative testing roadmap so we learn, not just spend

Monthly marketing report and weekly performance review

Ad hoc reporting: discounts, conversion rate, add to cart rate vs sessions, site search terms

Identify under and over performing products and change where we push spend



4. Influencers and content creators



Manage the UGC budget and creator roster

Work with our Social Media Manager to review and share successful content.

Identify new creators using our existing database and Meta Content Marketplace

Write content briefs

Outreach, negotiation and agreements

Track delivery and usage rights

Make sure every asset we pay for gets reused across paid and organic



5. Marketing rhythm



Own the 
 marketing calendar boards, forward planning and task visibility for the team

Run the monthly marketing meeting

Competitor research and tracking, monthly

Customer research and surveys

Co-ordinate product launch execution across
, social, site and paid

Brand collaborations to boost organic engagement





What this role does not cover

So there is no confusion:
 marketing is owned by our
 Marketing Specialist, organic social posting is owned by our UK content manager, and the website is owned by our Ecommerce Manager. You co-ordinate with all three, you do not execute in their channels. Creative direction and final brand sign-off sit with the founder.





Required skills and experience

You will need at least 3 years of hands-on experience with:



Meta Ads Manager for an ecommerce brand. Campaign structure, creative testing, catalogue and product feed work, custom and lookalike audiences.

Google Ads and Google Merchant Centre, including Shopping and Performance Max, feed diagnostics and disapproval fixes.

Managing a real budget to a target, with ROAS and CPA accountability. Tell us the numbers you have moved.

Ad copywriting and creative production in Canva, working to an existing brand kit.

Reporting and analysis, comfortable in Google Analytics, Shopify analytics and spreadsheets.



Written British English must be strong. Spelling, grammar and punctuation to UK standard: jewellery not jewelry, colour not color, personalised not personalized. Your ad copy goes live to UK customers.





Soft skills

Commercially minded. You think in margin and payback, not just impressions.

A self-starter. You bring us the plan, we do not brief you weekly.

Direct. If something is not working, you say so early. We would rather hear bad news fast.

Organised. Five workstreams, two brands, one calendar. Nothing falls through.

Curious about competitors. You watch what other jewellery brands are doing and tell us what is worth stealing.





Nice to have

Jewellery, fashion or accessories experience.

Klaviyo familiarity, enough to build audience syncs.

Influencer or UGC programme management at scale.

Experience with Shopify product feeds and marketplace advertising.

Trade or wholesale marketing experience.





Work schedule

Part-time, 3 to 4 days a week, roughly 20 hours. There is scope to move to full time as performance grows.



Hours are flexible, but we need at least 2 hours of overlap with UK working time (8.30am to 4.30pm London) on the days you work. A weekly performance call is expected, plus the monthly marketing meeting which you run.



We honour most Filipino holidays. You will qualify for paid leave after a 3 month probation period.

title: AI-Assisted Technical Operator — Web Apps, Servers, VoIP
description:
Start your application with the word ORBIT so I know you read this post.



I run several US-based businesses on self-managed infrastructure: multiple Ubuntu servers, a set of Node.js/Next.js applications running under PM2 behind Nginx, PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, a custom internal CRM, roughly a dozen websites, and an Asterisk/FreePBX telephony system handling live inbound calls.



I'm looking for ONE person to own technical execution across all of it. This is not a virtual assistant role. I give you a scoped mission and expect a finished result - audited, fixed, tested, documented - without daily supervision. This role eventually carries server and database access, so references will be checked before that is granted.



WHAT A TYPICAL MISSION LOOKS LIKE



"Take this internal web application. Audit it for bugs, fix them, clean up the codebase, make sure it's production-ready for end users. Report what you found and what you changed."

"This application is partially built. Complete the remaining third-party integrations, test end-to-end against the existing spec, confirm it's stable under real usage."

"Audit these websites in Google Search Console. Fix indexing problems, schema errors, Core Web Vitals, and crawl issues. Show me before and after."

"Inbound calls are dropping on our phone system. Trace the full call path - dialplan, database state, backend workers, logs - find the root cause and fix it."

"Build an automation that moves data between two of our systems on a schedule, with retries, logging, and failure alerts."



You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as your primary leverage. That is expected and encouraged. But you must be senior enough to know when the AI is wrong - you review its output, you understand the code it produces, and you never push anything to production you can't explain line by line.



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



Node.js, Next.js, TypeScript, React

PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis

Ubuntu, Nginx, PM2, systemd, Git

Asterisk / FreePBX - dialplan, SIP trunks, DID management, call routing

REST APIs, webhooks, third-party integrations, automation workflows

Google Search Console, technical SEO



REQUIRED



4+ years building and maintaining production web applications

Daily hands-on use of AI coding agents against real codebases, not occasional ChatGPT questions

Comfortable in a Linux terminal on servers you did not set up yourself

Can read an unfamiliar codebase and locate the bug without hand-holding

Traces problems end-to-end through logs, database state, and configuration before guessing

You finish what you start. You test before calling it done. You document what you changed.

Strong written English - you will be sending me findings and reports



STRONG PLUS



Asterisk, FreePBX, or any SIP/VoIP experience

n8n, Make, or similar automation platforms

Multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Technical SEO across many sites

Experience being the only technical person in an organization



NOT A FIT IF



You need daily supervision or task-by-task instruction

Your experience is only on managed platforms (Vercel, Netlify, WordPress hosting)

You have never administered a Linux server or touched telephony

Your approach is pasting code into an AI and forwarding whatever comes back



PROCESS



Short intro call, then a PAID technical assessment (4-6 hours of real work on an isolated staging environment). Long-term, full-time position with room to grow into owning the full stack. You will need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time.



TO APPLY - ANSWER THESE FOUR QUESTIONS



Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



Q1. Describe a production bug you found in code you did not write. How did you trace it to root cause?



Q2. Which AI coding tool do you use, on what kind of work, and give me one specific example where it was confidently wrong and you caught it.



Q3. Have you worked with Asterisk, FreePBX, or any VoIP system? What specifically did you do?



Q4. A Node.js app on Ubuntu is returning 502 errors. Walk me through your first 10 minutes.
